- 
 You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

- 
 You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

- 
 You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

 What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) 

- 
 2+ years of full-cycle sales experience within the software or security industry

- 
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

- 
 Progressive selling experience engaging with accounts

- 
 Demonstrate curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

- 
 Established relationships with current and prospective customers with a deep understanding of how technology facilitates high-level business goals

- 
 Proficiency in strategic sales planning with a proven track record of closing net new logos

- 
 Experience meeting or exceeding sales targets through the effective use of channel partnerships

 You’ll be responsible for owning the business relationship with your client(s), agency, and team, in addition to ensuring the successful delivery of programmatic campaigns.  About the role
 We’re looking for a Revenue Data Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team and help the business make better data-driven decisions. You’ll analyze revenue data, build the reports and dashboards our teams rely on, and help improve how we use our CRM, with Salesforce at the center.
 This role sits at the intersection of data and operations. You’ll translate business questions into analysis, and analysis into process improvements. Because we’re in the middle of an integration, you’ll often work with data from different systems and help bring structure where it’s still evolving. That’s a real challenge, and also a great opportunity to shape how revenue data works across the company.

- Analyze revenue streams, customer behavior, transactions, and usage trends to identify growth opportunities.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

- A detail-oriented, proactive approach: you spot issues, dig into them, and resolve them independently.

 Nice to have

 What We Offer

About Freshpaint : 

 Healthcare is a $4+ trillion industry in the U.S. alone, and it’s undergoing a rapid digital transformation.

 Hospitals, digital health companies, and life sciences organizations rely on analytics and advertising tools to reach patients, measure performance, and grow. But those tools weren’t built for regulated healthcare data. That creates real compliance risk and forces teams to choose between growth and privacy.

 Freshpaint eliminates that trade-off. 

 We’re a privacy-first data platform that helps healthcare organizations use modern marketing and analytics tools without exposing protected health information (PHI). Freshpaint sits between a company’s website or app and the third-party tools they use, automatically detecting and controlling sensitive data before it’s shared.

 In short: we let healthcare teams move fast, safely.

 Backed by Top Investors 

 Freshpaint is backed by some of the most respected names in technology, including:

- 
 Y Combinator (OpenAI, Stripe, Airbnb, Coinbase, DoorDash)

Who we are 
 Flow Pouch makes functional mushroom pouches. People use them as a clean alternative to nicotine pouches and energy products: no nicotine, no caffeine, no crash. We launched in 2024, we have grown quickly, mostly through subscriptions, and we manufacture in the US. We are a remote team of about 30 people globally.
 Why we are hiring 
 Most of our revenue comes from subscribers, so how long people stay with us matters as much as how many we acquire. Today retention is split between the founders, our support team and a set of tools that nobody owns end to end. We want one person who owns the whole customer experience after the first click: the website, the package that arrives, the emails and messages in between, and the reasons people stay or leave.
 We consider this the most revenue-critical seat in the company. The founders will be in the room from the first conversation, and whoever takes it will have their full backing and budget to build the function properly.
 You would report to our co-founder who runs operations and work closely with our CMO and co-founder on messaging. The Shopify developer and the web and brand designer we are hiring at the same time will report to you.
 What you will own 

- Retention, end to end. Repeat purchase rate and subscription retention, especially in months two and three, are your numbers.

- The retention tools we already have, and the ones we are missing. Keep what works working, improve it, and build what is not there yet, starting with a loyalty program.

- Every customer touchpoint. Review the full customer journey, from the website to the package to everything post-purchase, and make it coherent: same message, same brand, no gaps.

- The website as an experience. A Shopify developer and a web and brand designer work under you to keep the site consistent and ship the changes you prioritise.

- Our community. Grow our Facebook community of Flow customers and make it part of why people stay.

- The numbers. A clear weekly view of retention, repeat purchase and the metrics our support team reports, so the founders know where we stand.

 What this role is not 
 Customer support (reps, refunds, chargebacks) has its own lead and keeps running as it does today; over time that team will sit under you. This is not a brand strategy role and not a paid acquisition role. Our CMO owns messaging and acquisition; you make sure that what happens after the purchase lives up to it.
 Who we are looking for 

- You have owned retention or lifecycle at a subscription or consumable DTC brand at meaningful scale, at Director level or above, and you can show the numbers you moved: cohort retention, repeat rate, LTV.

- You have built a retention function, or a large part of one, rather than inherited a finished machine: the tools, the team, the reporting, the experiments.

- You are hands-on with the Shopify ecosystem, Klaviyo or an equivalent email and SMS platform, a subscription app (Recharge, Skio or similar), post-purchase and loyalty tools, and analytics.

- You have managed a team or outside vendors and are comfortable briefing a developer and a designer.

- You are hungry to try things nobody in the category has tried, and you are still happy doing unglamorous work, from packaging vendors to flow audits.

- A consumables or wellness background is a plus.

- You are based in the US, or in Europe with a working day that overlaps US Eastern hours.

 What is hard about this 
 We would rather you hear it now than in month three:

- The role is a generalist one at the start. You own the strategy and do a lot of the work yourself until the team around you is in place.

- Some of what you need to know lives in the founders' heads. Expect to ask, document and build the first version of things.

- Priorities change quickly. We decide fast and expect the same from you.

- Our support lead has a direct line to our co-founder who runs operations today. You earn the team's trust through results, not through the org chart.

 The engagement 
 Type
 Full-time.
 Compensation
 Very competitive, set with the person. We would rather hear your expectation than anchor you with a number.
 Location
 Remote. US preferred; Europe with US Eastern overlap also works.
 Reports to
 Our co-founder who runs operations.
 Team
 The Shopify developer and the web and brand designer report to you once hired.
 Start
 November 2026.
 How to apply 
 Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile, plus short answers to three questions:

- The subscription or consumable brand where you owned retention. What were the retention numbers when you arrived, what did you change, and where were they when you left?

- Go through as a customer. What is the first thing you would change after the purchase, and why?

- Your location, time zone, notice period and earliest start date.

NetBox Labs is seeking a Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience to join our Observability Team. Observability is a key component of network automation, and critical to our company mission to make it easier to build and manage complex networks.

 This team is responsible for Network Discovery & Reconciliation, Network Observability & Monitoring, and Agents & Fleet Management. The team delivers both closed and open source software and owns projects such as Orb , Diode and pktvisor .

 In this role you will bring: 

- 
 Deep experience with idiomatic Go

- 
 Experience with protobuf APIs (gRPC and Connect RPC), PostgreSQL (including migrations), Redis, and RabbitMQ

- 
 Experience with multi-tenant services, OAuth2/OIDC, and event-driven systems, including at-least-once delivery and idempotent consumers

- 
 Deep knowledge of observability and instrumentation, including OpenTelemetry

- 
 A solid understanding of networking: devices, configuration, protocols, and layers

- 
 The ability to use coding agents day to day: set the constraints, review the output, and remain accountable for correctness, security, and tests

- 
 Great communication skills, including the ability to write technical specifications with diagrams

 You will work closely with: 

- 
 Product owners – to bring ideas to life and deliver a compelling user experience

- 
 The NetBox team – to create the ultimate observability tooling within NetBox

- 
 The platform team – to ensure seamless integration with NetBox Cloud and Enterprise

- 
 Community members as users and contributors to the project

 It would be fantastic if you have the following experience: 

- 
 3+ years of experience working in a fast paced startup environment

- 
 MQTT or other device/IoT protocols, or gNMI

- 
 Kubernetes in production

- 
 Django, NetBox, or NetBox plugins

- 
 Python for tests and tooling

 About NetBox Labs: 

 NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

 NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

 NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Payments Product Manager (LATAM, Remote)
 Our client, a high-growth consumer subscription company, is hiring a Payments Product Manager to own their payments platform end to end. This is not a greenfield build. You inherit a modern stack — a first-party payments microservice, a payment orchestration layer routing across processors, BNPL, automated dunning, and a self-serve analytics layer — plus a dedicated engineering scrum team. Your job is to push it forward.
 Two priorities define the first six months. First, rebill recovery: a meaningful share of subscription rebills fail, and too many of those customers churn for payment reasons, not product reasons. You'll audit the dunning stack, evaluate vendors, and decide whether to optimize, switch, or layer. Second, initial auth rate: routing optimization, network tokenization, express checkout, and continuous experimentation at the checkout layer.
 In a given week you'll write a spec, pull your own numbers out of the data warehouse, negotiate a vendor SLA, and present findings to the CFO. There is no payments ops team behind you. When something breaks, you drive resolution. You set the roadmap, you ship, you measure.
 Requirements

- 5+ years in payments product or payments program management, subscription or e-commerce

- Hands-on experience with payment orchestration platforms and multi-MID routing

- Dunning and recovery expertise: retry logic, involuntary churn metrics, vendor evaluation

- Data self-sufficiency in modern BI tools — you don't wait on an analyst

- Demonstrated AI-native workflow: you actually use LLM and agentic tools in your product work today. This is a minimum qualification, not a preference.

- Comfortable owning chargebacks, fraud posture, and regulatory compliance context

- Remote, based in Latin America; overlap with US Eastern business hours required

 Benefits

- Fully remote

- Full-time contract via Maxana (long-term engagement)

- Compensation: $6,000–7,500 USD/month depending on experience

ABOUT 3Y HEALTH 

 3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into other specialties. We're backed by over $200mm from Founders Fund, General Catalyst, SoftBank and 8VC.

 ABOUT THE ROLE 

 We enter new markets by acquiring a foundational clinic for each specialty and region we go into, and we partner with independent clinics across the country. Every clinic adds entities, filings, contracts, staff records and deadlines that need to stay in order.

 In this role, you'll own a set of our entities from start to finish. When we acquire a clinic, you'll carry out its integration plan: collect and file the records, prepare the filings, get staff ready for day one and follow up with everyone until each item is closed. Each deal comes with a detailed plan and timeline from the deal lead. Acquired clinics keep running largely as they do today until we bring them onto our platform, usually within a few months. Once a clinic is integrated, you'll keep its entity in good standing, alongside the existing entities you own.

 The role is fully remote, with no travel.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 Acquisitions

- 
 Work through each deal's integration checklist from before signing through the first months after close, keep the tracker current, and flag anything at risk of slipping

- 
 Document how the clinic runs today, such as scheduling, intake, referrals and billing handoffs

- 
 Check that each acquired entity is in good standing, and that its legal name and tax ID match across IRS, state, bank and payer records

- 
 Support our team and advisors on payer change-of-ownership notices, Medicare enrollment updates and credentialing checks

- 
 Map every payer's electronic payment setup (EFT/ERA) and each clinic's bank accounts, so our billing team can keep cash flowing through close

- 
 Prepare staff for day one: verify the employee roster, gather employment records for legal review, run license and exclusion checks, collect onboarding paperwork securely, and help get payroll, benefits and staff FAQs ready

- 
 Inventory each clinic's vendors, software and logins, collect business associate agreements (BAAs) for legal review, and track which systems switch to ours at close, later or not at all

- 
 Follow through after close on staff communication, moving patients of departing providers to remaining clinicians, lease and facility license items, and the former owners' transition commitments

 Entity management and corporate operations

- 
 Keep the entities you own in good standing, primarily by managing our vendors: prepare annual reports, state registrations, IRS updates and other filings, and track them to on-time filing with our legal team

- 
 Maintain entity records, including formation documents, officers, registered agents and ownership

- 
 Prepare and submit provider and facility enrollments with state Medicaid programs and other public payers, and track them to approval

- 
 Make sure incoming mail for your entities is logged, routed and acted on, especially anything with a deadline

- 
 Prepare contracts from templates, route them for signature, and keep our contract management system and renewal dates current

- 
 Note what worked and what didn't, so our checklists get better with each deal

 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

- 
 2–5 years in healthcare operations, practice management, credentialing or provider enrollment, or acquisition integration

- 
 A track record of managing many details and deadlines to completion

- 
 Comfort working with contracts, licenses and government forms. You read carefully and catch errors.

- 
 Spreadsheet skills, and quick to learn new systems

- 
 Clear, professional writing to clinic staff, vendors and state agencies

- 
 High agency and low ego. You run your own checklist, don't need to be managed, and will do the tedious work as readily as the strategic work.

- 
 Based in the US

 NICE TO HAVE 

- 
 Experience at a multi-site practice, MSO, DSO or other healthcare roll-up, ideally in ABA or other therapy services

- 
 Experience with change-of-ownership (CHOW) filings or Medicaid/Medicare enrollment

- 
 Daily use of AI tools to work faster

 If you meet most of the requirements and the role interests you, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every box.

 Project Hydrus is a scripted and conversational audio data collection project. We're looking for native-level speakers who can deliver natural, everyday-sounding speech — recordings that hold up whether you're reading a script or speaking spontaneously. 

 Please note: the recordings you produce may be used to create synthesized, AI-generated voices for conversational AI products. Full details on how your data is collected, used, shared, and retained are set out in a Consent Form, which you'll review and sign before any paid session recording begins. 

 What You'll Do If Selected: 

- 
 Two supervised sessions of approximately 4 hours each, guided in real time by a Session Director on a separate recording platform. 

- 
 Record scripted material in a natural, conversational tone — faithfully, without a polished, performed, or “announcer” delivery. 

- 
 Record unscripted, spontaneous speech on a given topic, matching the same warmth and pace as your scripted takes. 

- 
 Set up and manage your own recording space and equipment for session recording. 

- 
 Deliver all recordings entirely in the required language (with specific dialect), without code-switching into other languages or dialects. 

 What We're Looking For 

 Required 

- 
 Experience as a voice actor, actor, or theater performer, or a comparable performance background. 

- 
 Native or native-equivalent fluency in the required language (with specific dialect). 

- 
 Access to a quiet recording space, free of echo and background noise (acoustically treated for session recording, if selected). 

- 
 Owns or will acquire a dedicated, professional-grade microphone for the audition (e.g. RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti), upgrading to a qualifying USB condenser or XLR mic + audio interface for session recording if selected. Built-in laptop mics, AirPods, earbuds, and headsets are not accepted at any stage. 

- 
 Owns closed-back monitoring headphones (required for session recording if selected). 

- 
 Comfortable both self-directing for the audition and taking live direction from a Session Director in guided sessions. 

 Preferred (nice to have, not required) 

- 
 Professional voice-over experience (dubbing/ADR, audiobook, podcasting) in a conversational rather than commercial/announcer register. 

- 
 Baseline audio hygiene: comfortable setting mic distance and catching noise, clipping, or distortion yourself. 

- 
 An existing home recording setup already treated for sound. 

 Your Data & Privacy 

 Before any session recording, you'll be asked to review and sign a Consent Form covering how your voice recordings are collected, used (including to train synthesized/AI voice models), shared with approved partners, retained, and how to exercise your data rights (access, correction, deletion, and more, depending on where you live). If you'd like to review these terms before applying, contact us and we'll share a copy in advance.

You will review incoming vitals and symptom data for patients with hypertension, heart failure, and diabetes, working alongside Cadence nurses and nurse practitioners to act on risk between visits. This role sits inside Cadence's Clinical Intelligence workflows, where alerts are surfaced continuously and licensed clinicians decide what happens next.

This role is responsible for close, revenue recognition, and financial integrity, while partnering cross-functionally on systems, metrics, and strategic initiatives as the company matures. - Support the evolution of credit-based and usage-based billing models in partnership with Product and Ops.

- Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Operations to ensure contract alignment and clean revenue data.

- Provide finance input on pricing, packaging, deal structuring, and order workflows.

- Contribute to team growth and process maturity as the finance function scales.

 Qualifications

- 5–10 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, including direct SaaS exposure or software businesses (subscription billing, usage-based pricing, ARR/MRR metrics).

- Deep working knowledge of GAAP and ASC 606 for subscription and usage-based revenue models.

- Hands-on experience with ERP systems (NetSuite or Sage Intacct preferred), including implementation or major expansion.

 Nice to Haves

 About uPhone
 uPhone is an eSIM marketplace built for modern travellers, available at (). The service is operated by Targa Limited, a company registered in Hong Kong. The team is small, remote-first, and based across Europe and Asia.
 uPhone was founded on a simple belief: staying connected abroad should not be expensive, complicated, or stressful. The company sources eSIM data plans from multiple suppliers across 150+ countries so travellers can get a fair price — without hidden fees, locked contracts, roaming charges, or the plastic waste of a physical SIM card.
 What uPhone eSIM is, in practice: an eSIM is a digital SIM profile built into the phone. Customers choose a country, regional, or global data plan (5,000+ plans are listed, including unlimited-data options and a Globetrotter plan covering 150+ countries on one eSIM), pay securely (card or PayPal; other methods, including crypto on the Crypto eSIM checkout, are listed on the site), and receive a QR code by email — typically within seconds. They scan it in iPhone or Android settings and can be connected in under two minutes, with no store visit. The physical SIM stays in the phone, so the home number remains available. Plans are data-only; calls and texts abroad are made over apps such as WhatsApp, FaceTime, or iMessage. Monthly and yearly plans are available for trips of 30 days or more. Plans are listed from about $2, with no contract.
 uPhone publishes 24/7 customer support via live chat and email (the help centre cites a typical response time under two minutes), a 30-day unused-eSIM refund if the QR code has not been scanned and the eSIM has not been installed or activated, and a rating of 4.8/5 from 50,000+ travellers who trust the service.
 Company values, as stated on the About Us page: transparency (what you see is what you pay), simplicity (purchase to connected in under two minutes), reliability (24/7 support and a clear refund policy), and sustainability (digital eSIMs mean zero plastic waste).

- 
 Location: Remote (LATAM, Philippines, or India). You must keep at least 5 hours of daily overlap with U.S. Pacific Time business hours.

- 
 Compensation: $3,200 - $3,600 USD per month ($38,400 - $43,200 annually)

- 
 Reports to: VP of Finance

- 
 Team: Finance

About TubeScience 

- 
 TubeScience is a performance-driven creative and media company that helps brands create, test, and scale high-performing video advertising.

- We work in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment where accuracy, ownership, and thoughtful service matter.

- We’re looking for an experienced payroll professional to fully own U.S. payroll, contractor payments, and Employer of Record (EOR) payroll support across the company, and to help build the payroll function as we grow.

- This role is hands-on, with no direct reports to start. You’ll run payroll independently, solve complex issues, and build reliable processes and controls. It calls for professional maturity, independent judgment, and deep, hands-on U.S. payroll expertise.

 The Role

- You’ll be the company’s payroll owner, accountable for how payroll runs from start to finish. You’ll partner closely with Finance, HR, Accounting, employees, and external payroll partners.

- Success in this role means our people are paid accurately and on time, payroll data stays clean, and discrepancies are resolved quickly. It also means our processes stay compliant and audit-ready as the company grows.

 What You’ll Do

- Own regular and off-cycle U.S. payroll processing in Rippling.

- Validate payroll inputs, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, deductions, and reimbursements.

- Administer and reconcile contractor payments.

- Coordinate payroll and bonus processing for employees engaged through EOR partners.

- Validate EOR payroll calculations, and reconcile invoices and statements against internal records.

- Manage multi-state payroll requirements, including tax withholding, overtime, final pay, state registrations, tax notices, filings, and reconciliations.

- Administer benefits deductions, garnishments, retirement contributions, and other payroll deductions.

- Keep payroll and employee data in Rippling accurate, and troubleshoot configurations, reports, workflows, and records.

- Investigate payroll discrepancies, find root causes, and drive issues through to resolution.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for employee payroll questions.

- Support payroll-related audits, census requests, and benefits or insurance reviews.

- Manage year-end payroll activities, including W-2/1099 processing, annual reconciliations, and related tax requirements.

- Build and maintain payroll SOPs and controls, and find ways to improve accuracy, efficiency, and audit readiness.

 Who You Are
 You’re an experienced payroll professional who has directly owned U.S. payroll. Your experience goes beyond coordinating payroll inputs for another person or provider to process.
 You have:

- 5+ years of payroll experience, including at least 3 years directly administering U.S. payroll.

- Hands-on experience processing payroll in Rippling.

- Experience managing multi-state U.S. payroll. California and/or New York experience is strongly preferred.

- Hands-on experience applying California overtime rules, tax exemptions, and state final-pay requirements.

- Strong knowledge of U.S. payroll taxes, wage deductions, federal and state requirements, and off-cycle payroll.

- Experience independently investigating and resolving payroll discrepancies.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, particularly for reconciliations and payroll reporting.

- Strong numerical reasoning and exceptional attention to detail.

- Professional fluency in spoken and written English.

- Strong communication and customer-service skills for handling sensitive employee payroll questions.

- The ability to work independently, manage recurring deadlines, and take ownership in a fast-paced environment.

 Bonus Experience

- Payroll tax registrations, notices, and agency correspondence.

- 401(k), workers’ compensation, or payroll tax audits.

- Employee census requests and benefits reconciliations.

- EOR payroll administration.

- Contractor payment administration.

- Year-end W-2 and 1099 processing.

- Supporting a U.S.-based company remotely from outside the U.S.

- Building or maturing a payroll function at a startup or high-growth company.

 You’ll Thrive Here If You…

- Take ownership of problems from the moment you spot them until they’re resolved.

- Care deeply about accuracy and catch discrepancies others might miss.

- Are comfortable investigating complex payroll issues on your own.

- Balance strong controls with the need to move quickly.

- Communicate clearly and patiently with employees and internal stakeholders.

- Want to shape how payroll operates, making processes more reliable rather than just following existing ones.

 This Role Probably Isn’t For You

 Tired of traditional jobs that expect you to build your life around a fixed schedule? At ShyftOff, we believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around!
 We're changing the way customer service works by connecting independent professionals with exciting opportunities to support established businesses, all from the comfort of home.
 Whether you're looking to earn extra income, take greater control of your schedule, or explore a flexible remote opportunity, ShyftOff gives you the freedom to work differently.
 Why Choose ShyftOff? 
 No commute. No traditional fixed schedule. More flexibility. More control.

- 100% Remote: Forget the commute! Work from the comfort of your own home.

- Weekly Pay: Get paid every week for eligible completed work.

- You Make Your Schedule: Choose available shifts that fit your lifestyle. Work when opportunities align with your availability.

- Earn $14-$20 Per Hour: Competitive campaign pay with opportunities to increase your earnings based on program and eligibility.
 Important: Applications will only be considered if you apply on the ShyftOff website at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents 
 The Role 
 As an independent agent, you take inbound calls for ShyftOff client programs and help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and get what they need. After you join, you choose which programs to apply for based on your qualifications and availability.
 One of our newest programs include:
 Financial Services Program — $15–$20 per hour plus incentives + $300 certification bonus 
 Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their banking cards for everyday life: activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. This is credentialed financial services work on an established account, built for people who want to meet a real bar and stick around.
 What you'll do:

- Handle inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions

- Help customers with payments, transfers, and disputes, accurately and securely

- Verify customer identity and follow strict security and compliance protocols on every call

- Spot and help resolve potential fraud with composure

- Document every interaction accurately in the account's systems
 Who you'll talk to: cardholders and their benefits managers, often at a stressful moment like a lost card or a charge they don't recognize. Your job is to guide them, protect their account, and get them back on solid ground.
 Healthcare Program — $14–$20 per hour plus incentives + $200 certification bonus 
 Compassionate, detail-oriented agents support a healthcare campaign, where your role is vital in providing clear information and support.
 What you'll do:

- Engage with customers to understand their concerns and provide solutions

- Clearly explain the breach details and the services offered to them

- Maintain a high level of empathy and professionalism in all communications

- Accurately submit CRM tickets to ensure effective issue resolution
 What Makes You a Fit (all programs) 

- Communication: you connect over the phone, listen well, and stay empathetic even when the caller isn't calm

- Security and accuracy: you take protecting sensitive information seriously

- Tech comfort: you can move between multiple systems and databases at once

- Composure: you think clearly and solve problems in a fast-paced environment

- Remote customer service or contact center experience is a strong plus; 3+ years of customer service experience preferred
 What You'll Need (all programs) 

- Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum)

- A quiet, professional home workspace suitable for customer calls

- Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding
 Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed.

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical Product Owner (Contractor) for two AI Pods that build the foundations of Numa, Enumerate ’s AI product line, including Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist. This role is focused on execution, not product strategy or roadmap direction. The Product Owner will own and detail the AI Pod backlog, lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for every release, document test findings clearly, and analyze customer usage and metrics to inform what gets built next. The role reports to the Director of Product Management and works closely with Product Managers and Engineering. This is a strong fit for someone with a QA background who has recently moved into a product role and wants to grow in product management working on live, customer-facing AI products.

Enumerate is looking for a Staff Accountant to join our team! 

 As part of our goal to create and support the best community association management software, Enumerate offers accounting solutions for clients. As a Staff Accountant, you will be responsible for performing bank reconciliations and preparing financial statements for Enumerate’s Financial Services clients. This is a hands-on role that requires experience working in the HOA/COA industry. The ideal candidate has a strong attention to detail,, a passion for continuous improvement, and a proven ability to leverage technology to improve efficiency, quality, and business outcomes.

 This is a contractor engagement eligible to applicants located in LATAM. 

 Key Responsibilities 

- Manage the monthly close: Record and review journal entries, accruals, prepaid expenses, and other adjustments; meet established close deadlines. 

- Reconcile accounts: Reconcile bank accounts, balance sheet accounts, and supporting schedules; research and resolve discrepancies. 

- Oversee A/P and A/R accuracy: Review transaction coding, payment activity, owner balances, deposits, and receivables for accuracy and proper supporting documentation. 

- Prepare financial statements: Produce and review monthly financial packages, including the balance sheet, income statement, general ledger, and supporting schedules. 

- Analyze financial results: Compare actual results to budget, identify unusual variances, and provide clear explanations to clients and management. 

- Maintain accurate records: Ensure transactions are posted to the correct association, account, and period, with complete documentation and an audit trail. 

- Support annual budgets and audits: Assist with budget preparation, audit requests, year-end schedules, and other client reporting needs. 

- Respond to client / internal questions: Explain financial results, research accounting issues, and coordinate timely resolutions with the appropriate EFS teams. 

- Follow controls and procedures: Apply EFS policies, client-specific requirements, and approval controls; escalate risks, errors, or recurring process issues. 

- Manage portfolio deadlines: Track deliverables across assigned communities and communicate early when information or action is needed to complete work on time. 

 Qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in accounting/appropriate field of study or comparable work experience 

- 3+ years of experience as a Staff Accountant

- Property management accounting experience is a bonus!

- Experience with creating financial statements, general ledger functions and the month-end/year end close process 

- Experience with accounting software

- Speed and accuracy are essential for this role which requires multiple financials prepared and issued daily

 Total monthly compensation:

 $2,700—$3,200 USD

vacantes.descripcion:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone. 
   You build production agent systems that run themselves. Not prompts, loops. Not a single assistant, a coordinated swarm. 

 The role:
 We build and ship agent platforms that do real work in production. This role is for an engineer who designs self-running agent loops and multi-agent swarms, not someone who tweaks prompts one turn at a time. You will own systems that find work, do it, verify it, and report back, with humans at the gates rather than in every iteration.
This is a hands-on, ship-first engineering role. You write production code other engineers trust, and you treat agents as software systems that need triggers, budgets, stop conditions, verification, and observability like any other.
 What we mean by loop engineering: designing an agent system as a control loop with an explicit trigger, scope, action, budget, stop condition, and report, plus a verifier that can reject bad work, so it runs unattended and knows when to stop or hand back to a human. Not a bigger prompt. A system that prompts the agents for you.
 What we mean by swarm agents: a coordinated fleet of specialized agents (planner, builder, reviewer, verifier, scout, coordinator) with file and task ownership, shared state, quality gates, and clean handoffs, run by an orchestrator rather than one do-everything assistant.

 What you'll do 

- Design self-running loops. Define the trigger, scope, action, budget, stop condition, and reporting so an agent runs unattended, stays inside cost and iteration limits, and knows when it is done versus when to escalate.

- Build multi-agent swarms. Orchestrator plus specialized agents with clear file and task ownership, shared state or a shared mailbox, quality gates between stages, and handoffs that do not step on each other.

- Make verification first-class. Build the part of the system that can say no: the checks, evals, and reviewer agents that catch confident mistakes before they merge. A loop is only as trustworthy as its ability to check its own work.

- Own agent state and memory. Persistent on-disk state and per-turn context assembly so long-running tasks survive restarts and the system does not forget what the repo already knows.

- Ship the platform around the agents. APIs, services, queues, and integrations in TypeScript and Node, deployed to AWS, with real tests, tracing, and observability for long multi-iteration runs.

- Keep humans in the loop where it counts. Plan approval and pull request review, and active management of comprehension debt so the team understands what the swarm ships, not just that it shipped.

 What we're looking for 

- Strong engineering fundamentals. 5+ years writing production software that other engineers depend on. (Adjustable; we care more about what you have shipped than the number.)

- Hands-on loop engineering. You have designed agent loops with explicit stop conditions, budgets, retries, and self-verification. You can explain the difference between a task on repeat and a real loop, and you know why the verifier matters as much as the maker.

- Multi-agent or swarm experience. You have built or operated systems where multiple agents coordinate: orchestration, handoffs, shared state, ownership or locking, and quality gates.

- Fluency with modern agent tooling. Claude Code or Codex style agents, sub-agents, persistent memory and skills files, tool and function calling, MCP, and reason-act-observe loop patterns.

We create result-focused strategies and content to drive SEO, social engagement and leads for our clients. Our teams continuously build expertise across new media formats, including video, blogs, infographics and web design.

 We're looking for a Full Stack Developer who loves building clean, performant interfaces and knows their way around a CMS well enough to make the backend work for the frontend, not against it. You'll spend most of your time in HTML, CSS/SASS, and JavaScript — building custom Gutenberg blocks, theming, and pixel-perfect implementations from design mockups — while staying comfortable enough in PHP and WordPress/Drupal internals to troubleshoot, extend, and integrate when needed.

 Work within Drupal for client sites that require it — theming, content types, and module-level troubleshooting

- 
 Collaborate directly with designers, consultants, and occasionally clients to solve problems and refine implementations

- 
 Use AI tools like Claude Code to plan out and execute aspects of a large project.

 What You Bring

 Must-haves 

- 
 5+ years of professional frontend development — strong HTML, CSS/SASS, and JavaScript fundamentals

 Solid working knowledge of PHP (7.x/8.x) — enough to read, debug, and extend WordPress/Drupal codebases confidently

 Practical Drupal experience — theming, content architecture, or module-level work

 Familiarity with WordPress hooks/filters and general LAMP-stack conventions (MySQL, Git)

- 
 Strong communication skills and comfort collaborating in a remote, client-facing environment

- 
 Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude Code.

 Nice-to-haves 

- 
 Experience with React or Angular

- 
 Laravel or Symfony

- 
 Docker and Linux environment familiarity

- 
 AWS or other cloud platform exposure

 Why Brafton

 100% remote, full-time role with a US-based team lead and a genuinely collaborative, cross-office culture spanning five countries.

 Compensation

 Plus commission

 About the Role 

 We're hiring on behalf of a US client looking for an L2 Incident Management / Support Analyst to join their team full-time. In this role, you'll receive system alerts, interpret what they mean, and follow runbooks to restart servers or services and resolve the issue. When a runbook isn't enough, you'll escalate — but only after digging deep enough to understand what's really going on.

 You'll work closely with the client's internal team and keep clients updated through Teams or Slack while incidents are being worked on and once they're resolved. This is a full-time role (40 hrs/week),5 days per week, with overlap during U.S. business hours. Some weekend coverage may be required on a rotating basis, coordinated with the team, to ensure continuous 24/7 support coverage.

- Monitor alerts and incidents using tools like Dynatrace, Datadog, Kibana, Google Analytics, and QuantumMetric

At Luminize , we help brands win. As a top 5 Amazon seller in the US by volume, we're growing fast, and great hiring starts with a great first screen.
 We are looking for a Candidate Screening Specialist to own the qualification step between application and recruiter. You will review inbound applicants, run structured screening interviews, and keep clean, consistent records in our applicant tracking system (ATS). You will screen for roles across our San Diego corporate team and our warehouse and fulfillment operation in Fort Worth, Texas. This is a focused role. Your job is to hold a consistent, fair bar across high volume screens so our recruiters spend their time on candidates who are truly ready.
 If you take pride in sound judgment, clear notes, and doing the details right every time, we would love to meet you!
 🎯 What You'll Be Doing 

- Review inbound applications and resumes against role requirements, keeping the applicant queue current with no aged applications

- Conduct structured phone and video screening interviews using an approved screening guide and scorecard

- Write concise, evidence-based screen notes in ATS, working from meeting transcripts

- Make advance or decline decisions at the screening stage, and apply an accurate reason code to every candidate you disposition

- Flag strong candidates who may fit a different open role, and escalate patterns such as off-profile applicants or screening guides that don't reflect the role

- Support general upkeep of the ATS so job posts, application questions, candidate emails, and reporting stay accurate

 🏆 What Success Looks Like 

- Recruiters consistently agree with the candidates you advance. Quality matters more than volume.

- Every applicant is reviewed promptly, and every screen is documented the same day

- Every dispositioned candidate carries a clear reason code, giving our team reliable hiring data

- Candidates leave your screen with an accurate picture of the role and a professional impression of Luminize 

 ✅ What You Bring 

- 3+ years recent experience conducting candidate screens and structured interviews

- US-market recent recruiting experience

- Fluent professional English required, written and spoken with the ability to build rapport quickly

- Experience with an ATS (i.e JazzHR)

- Familiarity with AI and video interview platforms (i.e. Fathom)

- Ability to assess candidates against a defined scorecard rather than personal impression, and to accept calibration feedback

- Working knowledge of EEO and non-discrimination principles in screening, including topics that should not be asked

- Concise written assessment skills: you document evidence, not impressions

- Strong attention to detail and the discipline to keep records accurate under time pressure

- Discretion with confidential candidate information

- Ability to work 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time, Monday through Friday

- Reliable high-speed internet with backup power, and a quiet workspace suitable for video interviews

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

 About Luminize 
 Luminize is a full-service Amazon growth partner helping brands succeed in a competitive digital marketplace. From creative strategy to advertising and analytics, we combine expertise and hustle to drive results for brands in CPG, health, wellness, beauty, and beyond.
 Luminize also operates as Coastal Trading Ventures (CTV), our warehouse and fulfillment operation in Fort Worth, Texas. CTV keeps products moving from the dock to the customer, giving us end-to-end control of the brand experience from listing to delivery.
 We are not your typical agency, and we like it that way. We operate with transparency, celebrate wins often, and treat every brand like it's our own.
 If you are ready to work with great people, do work that matters, and keep growing, we would love to meet you!

- Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English skills are required, including polished client correspondence and professional communication with US-based stakeholders.

- CRM Proficiency: Previous experience with CRM systems, with a strong preference for HubSpot CRM management and pipeline maintenance. Skilled at using performance data and CRM dashboards to surface improvement opportunities and hold team accountable to sales metrics

- HubSpot

- Humble: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and prioritizes team success over individual recognition.

- Smart: Possess strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence, enabling effective communication and collaboration.

- Base Salary:$20,000 to $30,000 per year, depending on experience, qualifications and fit.

- Paid Time Off: Generous PTO policy and holidays that reflect your beliefs and traditions.

- Professional Development: Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning to advance your career.

- Wellness Programs: Employee wellness programs that promote a healthy and positive work environment.

- Company Equipment: State-of-the-art equipment provided to ensure you have the tools you need to succeed.

- Travel: Occasional travel to events as required.

Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust. 

 In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information. 

- Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment 

- Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories 

- Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance 

- Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness 

- Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models 

 Qualifications to succeed in this project: 

- Professional fluency in English 

- Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  

- Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content 

- Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture 

- Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities 

- Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher) 

- Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content 

- Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred) 

 Why join the project: 

- Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling 

- Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains 

- Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment 

- Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset. 

- Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance 

 Qualification path 
 How to get started: 

- Complete your contributor profile and application 

- Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given 

- Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process 

- Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training 

- Receive your project assignment and access credentials 

 Service Rates  

 The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour. 

 Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. 

 Independent Contractor Relationship 

 This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

   Our client is looking to build a modern, technology-enabled social media operation that combines content creation, organization, analytics, AI, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency and performance.

 Role Overview
 The AI-Driven Social Media Manager will build and manage an organized social media operation, focusing on content creation, digital asset management, scheduling, publishing, and performance tracking.
 The ideal candidate has experience creating engaging social media content, including graphics and carousels, and is comfortable testing AI tools, automation, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) workflows to improve content production and execution.

 Location
 Fully Remote (Work from Home) | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST 

 Key Responsibilities
 Content & Social Media Management

- Build and maintain an organized social media content system and workflow.

- Create engaging social content, including carousels, graphics, and platform-specific assets.

- Repurpose existing digital assets across social media channels.

- Manage content planning, production, scheduling, and publishing.

- Adapt quickly to changing priorities and trends.

 AI & Emerging Technology

- Stay current with AI technologies and tools for social media and content creation.

- Test AI tools and workflows to improve content production and management.

- Explore AI and MCP-based workflows to improve efficiency.

- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive social media processes.

 Analytics & Campaign Tracking

- Track and report on social media activity, content performance, and campaign results.

- Use UTM tracking to measure traffic and campaign performance.

- Test content formats, tools, and strategies, documenting the results.

- Provide insights and recommendations based on performance data.

 Qualifications
 Experience

- Experience managing social media and digital content.

- Experience creating carousels, graphics, and social-first visual content.

- Experience organizing content workflows and managing digital assets.

- Familiarity with social media analytics and UTM campaign tracking.

- Familiarity with AI tools for content creation and social media management.

 Skills

- Strong graphic design and content creation skills.

- Strong organizational and project management skills.

- Ability to create engaging, platform-specific social media content.

- Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly.

- Openness to using AI, automation, and MCPs in daily workflows.

- Ability to test new tools and evaluate their measurable value.

- Strong creativity, adaptability, and attention to detail.

- Analytical mindset with a focus on performance measurement.

- Proactive approach to experimentation and process improvement.

 Portfolio Requirements

- We’re looking for clear, visually engaging social content with strong typography, consistent branding, and carousels that make information easy to follow. We recommend sharing social graphics, carousels, and examples of repurposing existing assets, highlighting your contribution. Examples of AI-assisted content workflows and performance results are also welcome.

What Success Looks Like

- An organized system for managing social media content and digital assets.

- Existing digital assets are consistently repurposed across social channels.

- High-quality graphics, carousels, and social content are produced consistently.

- AI and emerging technologies improve social media execution.

- Content and technology experiments are regularly tested and documented.

- UTM tracking provides visibility into campaign performance.

- Reporting identifies what works, what needs improvement, and what to test next.

 Opportunity
 The AI-Driven Social Media Manager will have the opportunity to build a modern, technology-enabled social media operation from the ground up, combining creative content production, analytics, AI, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency and performance.

Ranking Copilot is a fast-growing software company used by law firms to prepare their legal directory submissions (Chambers, Legal 500, IFLR and others) and their pitches and proposals. Firms keep their matters, lawyers, clients and referees in one place and produce better submissions and pitches in far less time. Our clients are law firms in the UK, Europe and the US.
 This is a full-time, fully remote contractor role. We especially welcome people based in South America, Central America or Asia. Hours are mostly UK and European business hours, with some US overlap. We are flexible on the exact schedule as long as clients get calls in their working day.
 The role
 You will be the main contact for a set of law firm clients, from their first day to renewal.

- Onboard new firms: run kick-off calls, help them get their data in, and train their marketing and BD teams.

- Run regular check-in calls and answer day-to-day questions by email and chat.

- Spot firms that are not using the product and get them back on track before deadlines.

- Collect feedback and bugs, and pass them clearly to the product team.

- Own renewals for your accounts and flag expansion opportunities.

- Write short help articles and how-to guides.

 What we are looking for

- Native or native-level English, written and spoken. You will write to and speak with partners and marketing directors at law firms every day.

- At least 2 years of experience in customer support or a similar client-facing role, ideally at a B2B software company.

- Confident on video calls with senior professionals.

- Organised and reliable without supervision. We are a small remote team.

- Stable internet and a quiet place to take calls.

- Nice to have: experience with law firms, legal marketing or legal directories; HubSpot or Intercom.

 What you get

- Fixed monthly pay of USD 1,500 - 1,800, depending on experience.

- Shares in the company for people who perform well.

- Fully remote, flexible schedule.

- Direct work with the founders and real influence on the product.

 How to apply
 Please send:

- Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

- A 2-minute video (Loom is fine) telling us where you are based and why this role suits you.

- The hours you can work, in UK time.

Its current portfolio includes a variety of local service-based businesses—ranging from equipment dealerships to property and facility services—with additional acquisitions actively in progress. As the company continues to scale its portfolio of companies and team members, it is seeking a highly capable Executive Assistant to provide direct, high-level support to the Principal, helping ensure operations, commitments, and daily priorities run with structure, accountability, and efficiency. 
 About the Role The Executive Assistant is a high-ownership hybrid role combining executive support, operational coordination, and task management. This position works directly with the Principal, who operates at a fast pace and generates deals, ideas, and commitments quickly. The primary responsibility of this role is to be the system behind leadership: capturing commitments, managing calendars, triaging communication, and keeping day-to-day operations moving smoothly without letting details fall through the cracks. This is not a traditional administrative position focused solely on completing assigned tasks. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem-solver who thinks independently, exercises sound judgment, identifies what needs to happen next, and takes full ownership of getting it done. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Executive Support & Calendar 

- Manage and protect executive calendars, meetings, and daily schedules, ensuring proper buffer times and priorities are maintained. 

- Prepare leadership for meetings by providing key context, summary notes, and relevant documentation. 

- Triage incoming communications, email, and messages daily, drafting responses and flagging priority items (targeting daily Inbox Zero). 

- Translate voice memos, phone calls, and verbal commitments into written follow-ups, action items, and clear records on the same day. 

 Operations & Project Follow-Through 

- Maintain a centralized system to track open commitments, deadlines, and action items across internal teams and external parties. 

- Proactively follow up with stakeholders to ensure tasks and projects are completed on time. 

- Pre-read long documents, reports, and contracts to provide concise summaries and recommendations. 

- Support administrative coordination across residential and commercial property management, vendor communication, and invoice tracking. 

- Handle personal and administrative management, including subscriptions, vendor scheduling, and key document organization in shared drives. 

 Communication & Logistics 

- Coordinate equipment, vehicle servicing, orders, and deliveries remotely by phone and email through local teams. 

- Plan end-to-end travel logistics, including flights, transportation, lodging, and itineraries. 

- Serve as a clear, calm, and professional point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. 

 Technology & Systems 

- Build and maintain organized systems across Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets) and Slack. 

- Leverage AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to research, summarize, draft communications, and improve operational productivity while verifying data accuracy. 

- Identify opportunities to simplify workflows and automate repetitive administrative work.

 Requirements

- Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, Project Coordinator, or similar high-ownership support role for founders or senior executives. 

- Broad generalist background with the ability to comfortably manage diverse and shifting tasks. 

- Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills (Spanish fluency is a valuable asset). 

- Strong organizational, systems-building, and project tracking abilities with high attention to detail. 

- Proactive self-starter mindset with demonstrated ability to operate independently with minimal supervision. 

- Direct, calm, and confident communication style when interacting with fast-moving executives and teams. 

- High degree of discretion when handling confidential business, administrative, and personal information. 

- Tech-savvy with proficiency in Google Workspace, Slack, and AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT). 

 Technical Skills 
 Experience with the following tools is highly valued: 

- Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets) 

- Slack 

- AI Productivity Tools (Claude, ChatGPT) 

- Task-tracking and project management tools

- Growth opportunity: Opportunity to grow with a fast-growing company and take on increasing responsibility over time. 

- Location: LATAM.

This individual will support enterprise customers across cloud-hosted, self-hosted, and on-premises environments while collaborating with engineering and product teams.

 Technical Troubleshooting & Resolution

- Provide L2/L3 technical support for cloud replication and enterprise data integration solutions.

- Diagnose database connectivity issues, synchronization errors, replication failures, and performance problems.

- Read, debug, and write code or scripts to investigate and resolve technical issues.

- Troubleshoot applications across cloud-hosted, self-hosted, and on-premises environments.

 Enterprise Customer Support

 Technical Documentation & Process Improvement

 Qualifications

 FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. We free leaders up by saving them time and effort so they can focus on the work only they can do. For our EAs, we aim to be one of the best US companies for LATAM and Filipino talent, with a supportive environment and real room to grow.
 About the role
 We're looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to be the "second brain" for a fast-moving US entrepreneur. He runs a growing private aircraft sales business, where many leads come in through his social media content, and he co-owns a pool services company.
 You'll own his CRM, keep his sales team on track, stay on top of his calendar, files and travel, and help with the personal details that make life run smoothly. You won't just follow instructions: he wants someone who audits how things are done, spots gaps without being told, and suggests what to hand off next. This is a behind-the-scenes role. He handles all client calls and onboarding himself.
 Compensation: 1,000 to 1,700 USD (Depends on Experience)
 Location: Remote, LATAM
 Job Type: Full-time
 What you'll do
 1. Own the Notion CRM (ramps up gradually)

- Keep the aviation sales pipeline watertight: deal stages, last-contact dates and next steps always current.

- Add new and missing deals, including aircraft that go under contract, and flag stale records (for example, "last contact was months ago").

- After each recorded sales Zoom call, use the transcript and Claude to create the CRM entry with the contact's details, write next steps and delegate follow-ups to the right sales rep.

- Take over the CRM step by step as you learn the nuances of the business.

 2. Coordinate the sales team

- Follow up with the two sales reps so they stay on top of their leads and keep their deals updated in the CRM, without adding extra admin work to their plate.

- Make sure every deal has clear next steps and that aircraft listings get the visibility they need.

- Send him consolidated status overviews so he can see the whole pipeline at a glance.

 3. Manage Dropbox filing (from day one)

- Move aircraft photos, videos, spec sheets, sales brochures, maintenance status reports, contracts, LOIs, APAs and deposit confirmations from email into the right Dropbox folders as soon as they arrive.

- Follow a clear SOP and keep everything consistent as the team grows. Much of this material is sensitive or client-facing, so accuracy matters.

 4. Manage his calendar and reminders

- Manage his Outlook calendar and his availability for calls booked through Calendly.

- Handle reschedule requests and send short scheduling emails to clients when needed.

- Send a proactive end-of-day "here's tomorrow" text with his meetings, addresses, links, documents or waivers to sign, and anything he needs to bring, plus a suggested time for his daily workout around a busy schedule.

 5. Book travel

- Plan two to three mostly domestic trips a month, comparing options on Kayak and booking through airline apps.

- Follow his saved preferences: direct flights, no very early departures and exit row seats, with his traveler details on file.

- Handle booking, check-in and confirmations so everything is ready on his phone.

 6. Handle personal and admin tasks

- Take care of waivers, vehicle registrations and other paperwork for his trucks and businesses.

- Remember birthdays and anniversaries, and arrange flowers and gifts for his wife and kids within a set budget.

- Process payroll for his pool company (about six people).

- Possibly monitor GoHighLevel for new pool leads during your working hours and send quick text replies.

 Please note: this role does not include client calls or onboarding. He handles all client conversations himself. Beyond these tasks, he wants you to audit his systems, spot the low-hanging fruit and tell him what else you can take off his plate.

- Apply online

- Record a short Loom video introducing yourself/ Prescreen call with a recruiter

- Final Interview with our Recruiting Lead

- Complete a work evaluation

- Final interview with the client

 Requirements
 Must-haves

- At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Sales Coordinator or in a similar support role.

- A very proactive "second brain" who audits systems and spots gaps without being told.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented.

- Fast and responsive. He should never be left waiting.

- Disciplined and professional.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Comfortable handling both business and personal tasks.

- High discretion with client, financial and payroll information.

- Available full-time from 9 AM to 5 PM US Central Time.

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet home office setup.

 Nice-to-haves

- A good sense of humor and a likable personality.

- Experience with Notion as a CRM.

- Comfort using AI tools, especially Claude.

- Sales operations or high-ticket sales support

 Are you a highly motivated logistics professional with experience in specialized freight? We are looking for a solutions-oriented Bilingual Logistics Coordinator to join an established, family-owned freight brokerage with a clear path to becoming a commission-earning Account Manager!

 🚨 IMPORTANT - Watch this quick Loom video on how to get hired: 🔗 

 🗣️ C1 ENGLISH LEVEL IS REQUIRED. The selected candidate will be speaking strictly in English during their whole shift. 🎙️ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH. 

 📋 Job Details at a Glance 

- Job Title: Bilingual Logistics Coordinator

- Job ID: FRAPAM2R

- Industry: Freight Brokerage and Logistics

- Location: LATAM

- Job Status: Full Time

- Work Schedule: Thursday - Monday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (EST) (Tuesday & Wednesday off) 

- Salary: $1500 per month

- Target Start Date: ASAP

 🏢 About the Client 

 Our client is an established, family-owned logistics service provider and freight brokerage dedicated to empowering commerce through efficient and innovative supply chain solutions. Built on a foundation of integrity, sustainability, and long-term relationships, they operate as a deeply trusted partner for businesses across multiple sectors.
 They pride themselves on a culture of constant communication and total transparency, providing 24/7 round-the-clock service to ensure time-sensitive freight is delivered seamlessly. By blending industry experience with personalized care, they provide an agile, fast-paced environment where employees are empowered to grow and directly contribute to the success of global trade.
 💼 About the Role 

 We are seeking a highly motivated and solutions-oriented Bilingual Logistics Coordinator to join our team. In this role, you will start with a strong focus on tracking, tracing, and operational execution, with a clear trajectory to advance into a commission-earning Account Manager role.
 The ideal candidate possesses exceptional customer service, problem-solving abilities, and a basic foundation in logistics operations. Rather than general freight, this role prioritizes experience in specialized freight sectors, specifically Produce and Open Deck (Oversize, Overweight, and Overwidth) cargo.
 🎯 Key Responsibilities 

- Track & Trace: Provide high-level track and trace coverage, ensuring real-time shipment visibility and accurate system updates.

- Issue Resolution: Proactively problem-solve operational hurdles during weekend and peak-season shifts to prevent delivery delays.

- Carrier Coordination: Maintain accurate communication with carriers regarding load specifics, pickup/delivery addresses, and schedule adherence.

- Market Pricing: Learn and adapt to market pricing platforms to effectively quote and negotiate competitive rates with open-deck and produce carriers.

- Role Advancement: Smoothly transition from an internal operations support position to a client-facing account management role based on performance.

 📈 Tiered Career Path 

- Tier C (Entry / Track & Trace): Focuses heavily on track and trace, answering driver calls, verifying pickup details, and providing proactive client updates.

- Tier B (Operations Specialist): Introduces market-rate quoting, carrier sourcing, and carrier rate negotiations.

- Tier A / S (Account Manager): Full management of key clients, independent quoting, and carrier book management. At this stage, the role transitions to a Monday–Friday schedule.

 ✅ Qualifications & Skills 

 ⭐ Core Requirements:

- Bilingual: Fluent in both Spanish and English (Required).

- Core Experience: 1–2 years of experience in track and trace, logistics coordination, or a freight brokerage setting.

- Niche Expertise: Proven experience or strong familiarity handling Produce and/or Open Deck (Oversize / Overweight / Overwidth) freight is highly preferred.

- Competencies: Strong negotiation skills, confident telephone demeanor, and excellent multi-tasking capabilities.

- Problem-Solving: Strong customer service mentality with the capacity to stay calm and resourceful under high-pressure, peak-season conditions.

 💻 Systems & Software:

- Experience with Load Boards (DAT, Truckstop) is strongly preferred.

- Experience with Transportation Management Systems (specifically Tai Software) is strongly preferred.

- Experience with 3CX dialer systems is a plus.

Metro Vein Centers is a rapidly growing healthcare practice specializing in state-of-the-art vein treatments. Our board-certified physicians and expert staff are on a mission to improve people’s quality of life by relieving the painful, yet highly treatable symptoms of vein disease—such as varicose veins and heavy, aching legs.

 With over 70 clinics across 9 states , and still growing, we’re building the future of vein care—delivering compassionate, results-driven care in a modern, patient-first environment.

 We proudly maintain a Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 93 , the highest patient satisfaction in the industry.

 This is not a generic sales role.
 We’re hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) - internally named, Patient Intake Coordinator, with experience in medical call centers, front desk patient scheduling, or insurance-based sales . You’ll serve as the first voice a patient hears , managing phone conversations with empathy and urgency while verifying insurance, overcoming objections, and securing appointments across our 60+ clinics. As a Patient Intake Coordinator , your mission is to connect with prospective patients, bring clarity to their symptoms and treatment options, and confidently guide them to book a vein evaluation and ultrasound. You are the frontline driver of new patient growth, ensuring every interaction is patient-first, educational, and action-oriented.
 Success in this role requires a deep understanding of healthcare workflows , confidence navigating insurance barriers , and prior experience converting calls into booked visits .
 If you’ve worked in a medical practice, urgent care center, or dental front desk—and know how to guide patients, ask the right questions, and document accurately in EMRs—this is for you. 
 Language Skills 
We are now accepting applications for bilingual, English / Spanish speaking candidates only.

 Independent Contractors (Latin America only)

-

 Compensation structure is based on employment classification and work location. 

- 
 Schedule: Full-time | Includes evenings and one weekend day 

 What You’ll Do 

- Serve as the first point of contact for new patient leads

- Proactively connect with patients via inbound and outbound phone calls , email, and text

- Build rapport, answer questions, and guide patients to book consultations at over 60 nationwide clinics

- Communicate insurance coverage and payment options clearly to minimize booking barriers

- Verify insurance, initiate authorization requests, and manage CRM/EMR documentation

- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a seamless handoff to clinical care

- Continuously refine your approach based on feedback and performance data

 What Success Looks Like

- 
 Activity & Productivity: Maintain high engagement by making and taking up to 100 calls per day.

- 
 Conversion Performance: Achieve a 55%+ conversion rate on qualified calls.

- 
 Operational Excellence: Deliver a consistent, patient-first experience aligned with QA guidelines and document 100% of interactions accurately in CRM/EMR systems.

- Speed and efficiency in response times and follow-up

- Patient satisfaction scores (NPS, direct feedback)

 What You’ll Bring 

- 
 Drive & Resilience: A competitive work ethic and a "productivity mindset". You should be energized by scoreboards and metrics, with a high resilience to rejection.

- 
 Sales Execution: Strong persuasion and objection-handling skills. You are comfortable "controlling a conversation" and moving a patient from initial interest to a scheduled visit.

- 
 Operational Discipline: The ability to navigate multiple tools (CRM, EMR, and phone systems) simultaneously with high attention to detail under pressure.

- 
 Coachability: A commitment to growth, with the ability to act on coaching and feedback quickly to improve performance.

- 
 Background Preference: Experience in sales (e.g., cold calling) or high-volume service environments (e.g., military or hospitality) is highly valued.

- Bilingual in Spanish is a requirement

 Requirements

- Based in Latin America and working as an independent contractor (this role is not open to US-based applicants)

- Fluent in English and Spanish for live patient calls

- Available full time on US time zone hours, including evenings and one weekend day

- Your own computer, noise-cancelling headset, webcam, reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, private workspace

 How to Apply
 Submit your resume and answer the application questions. Qualified applicants are invited to a short one-way video interview on HireFlix, answered in English and Spanish.
