About Us
 Ovation Law Firm is a fast-growing, consumer-focused law firm committed to delivering exceptional legal services while fostering a high-performance, accountable, and supportive workplace. As we continue to scale, we are building strong client-focused systems to ensure consistency, compliance, and an outstanding experience from the very first interaction.
 We work closely with partner legal teams to connect injured individuals with the legal support they need, and our intake team plays a critical role in setting the tone for every client relationship.
 About the Role
 We are seeking a high-energy, empathetic, and motivated Legal Intake Specialist to serve as the first point of contact for individuals seeking legal help after an injury.
 In this role, your goal is to listen, qualify, and warmly introduce potential clients to our partner legal teams using an assumptive, sales-minded approach. You will guide callers through the early stages of their legal journey with confidence, compassion, and urgency, ensuring they feel heard, supported, and ready for the next step.
 This is a fast-paced position well-suited for individuals with backgrounds in legal intake, sales, customer service, call centers, or customer acquisition of any kind, who thrive in high-volume environments and know how to balance empathy with performance.
 Strong English communication skills are essential for success in this role.
 Key Responsibilities

- Respond to incoming inquiries via phone, web forms, and chat in real time, providing rapid, attentive support to individuals seeking legal help after an injury.

- Conduct concise (5–8 minute), compassionate discovery calls to gather and assess essential case details such as incident information, injuries, liability, and insurance status.

- Apply proprietary scripts and strict qualification criteria to quickly determine whether a case is a fit for partner legal teams.

- Use an assumptive, sales-minded approach to perform live warm transfers to our partner legal teams or schedule timely callbacks for qualified leads.

- Accurately document all caller information, case details, and outcomes in Salesforce, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.

- Manage follow-ups for pending leads, maintaining an organized pipeline and re-engaging prospects who were not ready to proceed on initial contact.

 Qualifications

- Strong English communication skills (C1 level), both verbal and written.

- Fully bilingual, fluent in both English and Spanish, with the ability to seamlessly support callers in either language.

- At least 1 year of experience in a high-volume call center, customer service, or medical/legal office environment.

- Exceptional verbal communication skills with the ability to mirror a caller’s tone, demonstrate empathy, and build rapport quickly.

- Sales-minded approach focused on educating callers and guiding them toward taking action on their personal injury matter.

- Tech-savvy and comfortable typing 45+ WPM while speaking with callers and navigating multiple software platforms simultaneously.

 Nice-to-Have / Preferred Qualifications
 The following experience is helpful but not required for success in this role:

- Personal injury intake experience.

- Experience with Salesforce.

 Requirements

- Ability to work independently from a home office with stable, high-speed internet and a quiet, professional workspace.

- Must have a laptop or desktop computer with a minimum of 16GB RAM and an Intel Core i5 processor or higher.

- Must have a stable internet connection with a minimum speed of 25 Mbps.

- Available to work U.S. business hours.

- Willingness to use time-tracking software.

 What We Offer

- Earn $8/hour DOE (full-time, 40 hours/week - including weekends).

- Performance based incentives.

- 100% remote work environment.

- 10 paid time-off (PTO) days per year.

- Opportunity to work closely with leadership and legal professionals in a growing, modern law firm.

 This position is only open to candidates located in LATAM. Resumes must be submitted in English. Applications that do not meet these criteria will not be considered.
Salary: $8 Hourly DOE Originally posted on Himalayas

About Us
 Ovation Law Firm is a fast-growing, consumer-focused law firm committed to delivering exceptional legal services while fostering a high-performance, accountable, and supportive workplace. As we continue to scale, we are building strong client-focused systems to ensure consistency, compliance, and an outstanding experience from the very first interaction.
 We work closely with partner legal teams to connect injured individuals with the legal support they need, and our intake team plays a critical role in setting the tone for every client relationship.
 About the Role
 We are seeking a high-energy, empathetic, and motivated Legal Intake Specialist to serve as the first point of contact for individuals seeking legal help after an injury.
 In this role, your goal is to listen, qualify, and warmly introduce potential clients to our partner legal teams using an assumptive, sales-minded approach. You will guide callers through the early stages of their legal journey with confidence, compassion, and urgency, ensuring they feel heard, supported, and ready for the next step.
 This is a fast-paced position well-suited for individuals with backgrounds in legal intake, sales, customer service, call centers, or customer acquisition of any kind, who thrive in high-volume environments and know how to balance empathy with performance.
 Strong English communication skills are essential for success in this role.
 Key Responsibilities

- Respond to incoming inquiries via phone, web forms, and chat in real time, providing rapid, attentive support to individuals seeking legal help after an injury.

- Conduct concise (5–8 minute), compassionate discovery calls to gather and assess essential case details such as incident information, injuries, liability, and insurance status.

- Apply proprietary scripts and strict qualification criteria to quickly determine whether a case is a fit for partner legal teams.

- Use an assumptive, sales-minded approach to perform live warm transfers to our partner legal teams or schedule timely callbacks for qualified leads.

- Accurately document all caller information, case details, and outcomes in Salesforce, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.

- Manage follow-ups for pending leads, maintaining an organized pipeline and re-engaging prospects who were not ready to proceed on initial contact.

 Qualifications

- Strong English communication skills (C1 level), both verbal and written.

- Fully bilingual, fluent in both English and Spanish, with the ability to seamlessly support callers in either language.

- At least 1 year of experience in a high-volume call center, customer service, or medical/legal office environment.

- Exceptional verbal communication skills with the ability to mirror a caller’s tone, demonstrate empathy, and build rapport quickly.

- Sales-minded approach focused on educating callers and guiding them toward taking action on their personal injury matter.

- Tech-savvy and comfortable typing 45+ WPM while speaking with callers and navigating multiple software platforms simultaneously.

 Nice-to-Have / Preferred Qualifications
 The following experience is helpful but not required for success in this role:

- Personal injury intake experience.

- Experience with Salesforce.

 Requirements

- Ability to work independently from a home office with stable, high-speed internet and a quiet, professional workspace.

- Must have a laptop or desktop computer with a minimum of 16GB RAM and an Intel Core i5 processor or higher.

- Must have a stable internet connection with a minimum speed of 25 Mbps.

- Available to work U.S. business hours.

- Willingness to use time-tracking software.

 What We Offer

- Earn $8/hour DOE (full-time, 40 hours/week - including weekends).

- Performance based incentives.

- 100% remote work environment.

- 10 paid time-off (PTO) days per year.

- Opportunity to work closely with leadership and legal professionals in a growing, modern law firm.

 This position is only open to candidates located in LATAM. Resumes must be submitted in English. Applications that do not meet these criteria will not be considered.
Salary: $8 Hourly DOE Originally posted on Himalayas

About Clipboard 

 Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

 Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

 About the role: 

 As an Onboarding Expert , you’ll be a key contributor to an excellent onboarding journey for new and reactivated workers on our app. You’ll guide them, cheer them on, solve blockers, and help them take their first step to making a difference.

 What You’ll Be Doing 

- 
 Make ~60 targeted outbound calls per day to Clipboard app users.

- 
 Host ~5 pre-booked 15-minute onboarding consultations daily .

- 
 Send follow-up emails and texts to answer questions and support worker onboarding.

- 
 Respond to inbound messages and support tickets .

- 
 Keep clear documentation of all interactions.

- 
 Identify pain points and opportunities for improvement in the worker experience.

- 
 Be the go-to guide and trusted partner helping professionals feel confident, supported, and ready to work their first shift.

 What Makes You a Great Fit 

- 
 You enjoy talking to people , helping them succeed, solving challenges, and getting them excited about Clipboard.

- 
 You’re comfortable making calls in a phone-heavy, fast-paced environment and love building rapport quickly.

- 
 You speak and write English clearly and professionally .

- 
 You’re organized, follow through on tasks, and don’t let things slip.

- 
 You’re curious, resourceful, and always looking for the root cause of a problem.

- 
 You’re quick with tools and not afraid to learn new systems.

- 
 You’re observant , recognize pain points and opportunities, and aren't afraid to step in and lead the charge on improvements.

- 
 Able to work weekdays in US Eastern Time. 

 Experience in inside sales, client onboarding, customer support, or healthcare recruiting is a plus - but not required. If you’re a quick learner with great communication skills, we want to hear from you.

 What This Role Is NOT 

- 
 Not cold calling - you’ll only speak with professionals who have accounts on the app.

- 
 Not technical support - you’ll guide workers but escalate deeper tech issues.

- 
 Not repetitive - every conversation is unique, and you’ll need to think on your feet.

 Why Join Clipboard 

- 
 100% Remote

- 
 Mission-driven work that improves lives

- 
 Supportive, collaborative international team

- 
 Career growth in a fast-moving tech company

 System Requirements 

 To succeed in this role, you must have:

- 
 A reliable laptop/desktop (no Chromebooks or Linux OS).

- 
 Minimum 20 Mbps wired internet connection.

- 
 Wired headset for clear communication.

- 
 A quiet, distraction-free workspace.

- 
 Stable power and internet connectivity.

 Ready to empower healthcare professionals from day one? 

 Start your journey with Clipboard - fill out the form below, and let’s make an impact together. 

 Want to know more? Please feel free to check out our Remote Work Guidelines .

 Quick Note on Scammers: 

 Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here .

Job Title: Operations Coordinator
Location: Remote — South Asia, LATAM, Southeast Asia preferred
Eligibility: India, LATAM, Philippines preferred
Salary Range: 1000 – 1300 USD/month
Work Schedule: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (MST)
NOTE: INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR POSITION

 Company Overview

 Sagan is an exclusive membership community for top executives, founders, and CEOs seeking to hire and maximize the impact of international talent. We bridge the gap between global talent and US-based businesses, connecting candidates from vibrant regions like LATAM, Asia, and Africa with leading American companies. Sagan provides a high-performance remote work environment, ensuring access to world-class opportunities for top-tier professionals.
About the Company:
Sagan represents a fast-paced, service-oriented small business owner operating multiple service businesses. The businesses require a resourceful Operations Coordinator to manage communication with field teams and ensure service quality.

 Position Overview

 We are seeking a High-Level Problem Solver to serve as our remote Operations Coordinator. This role is the "Air Traffic Control" across our service businesses. You will be responsible for managing digital logistics, ensuring accountability among blue-collar field staff, and handling real-time client updates. The ideal candidate is assertive, thick-skinned, and comfortable holding others accountable. You must be able to troubleshoot scheduling issues and delays without panicking. You will be working in tandem with an in-office coordinator who handles on-site physical logistics.

 Key Responsibilities

- Creative Problem Solving: Actively troubleshoot scheduling conflicts, delays, and on-the-ground challenges. Don’t just report problems; bring solutions.

- Dispatch & Coordination: Coordinate daily team activities and confirm schedules with field staff (movers, educators).

- Accountability: Follow up with team members to ensure timely arrival and service delivery.

- Client Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact between customers and field teams, handling urgent concerns in real-time with empathy and authority.

- Admin & Records: Maintain up-to-date records in the CRM (Smart Moving) and ensure SOPs are followed.

- Team Alignment: Liaise with the business owner and the in-office coordinator to ensure operational alignment.

 Qualifications

- Problem Solving: Proven ability to take initiative and resolve complex logistical issues independently.

- Experience: 1+ years in operations coordination, logistics, dispatch, or service delivery support.

- Communication: Excellent verbal and written English. Must be able to communicate clearly and firmly with field staff.

- Reliability: Must have a reliable workstation and internet connection to support a consistent MST schedule (Night shift for Asian candidates).

- Tech Stack: Familiarity with CRMs (e.g., Smart Moving, Timesaver) is a major plus.

 Nice to Haves

- Experience in the Moving or Home Services industry.

- Background in bookkeeping or QuickBooks.

- Blue-Collar Management: Experience managing or coordinating field teams (e.g., movers, field technicians, contractors) is highly valued.

 Resume Submission Guidelines

 Paste your full resume in English in the required resume-text field. You may also upload one English, text-based PDF.

 How to Apply

 Use the Sagan Apply link attached to this listing to apply.

 https://saganrecruitment.com/a/d25-8600-nov12

 Schedule: Monday through Friday for either 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM or 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM Pacific Time.

 About the Role
 As a Bilingual Dental Virtual Assistant, you’ll take ownership of high-volume patient outreach, insurance verification, appointment scheduling, and follow-up across both dental offices. Outbound calling is the core of this position, so you should genuinely enjoy speaking with patients and be comfortable spending much of your workday on the phone.
 Your immediate priorities will include verifying insurance, scheduling six-month recall appointments, following up with patients, and completing postoperative care calls. As you build trust and demonstrate strong performance, you’ll have the opportunity to take on marketing lead follow-up and potentially grow into treatment coordination or broader dental administrative responsibilities.
 Responsibilities

- Own a consistent outbound calling workflow for patient recalls, appointment confirmations, postoperative follow-ups, and other priority outreach.

- Verify dental insurance eligibility and coverage before appointments by contacting insurance providers and patients as needed.

- Follow up with patients to collect missing or incomplete insurance information and keep records accurate and up to date.

- Re-engage patients who are due or overdue for six-month checkups and cleanings and help convert outreach into scheduled appointments.

- Confirm upcoming appointments and coordinate accurate scheduling across both dental office locations.

- Complete postoperative care calls, document patient feedback, and escalate clinical concerns to the appropriate dental team.

- Maintain clear, accurate call notes, insurance verification results, appointment updates, and follow-up records in the practice’s systems.

- Track outbound call activity, talk time, completed follow-ups, and other performance expectations consistently.

- Coordinate closely with office managers and administrative staff to keep patient communication organized across both practices.

- After training, follow up with prospective patients generated through Meta/Facebook campaigns, answer general questions, and help convert interested leads into attended appointments

 Requirements

 Must-Have: 

- Fluent spoken English and Spanish with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically with patients. 

- Experience in a dental, medical, patient coordination, reception, virtual assistant, or healthcare administrative environment. 

- Confidence performing high-volume outbound calling throughout the workday. 

- Experience scheduling patient appointments and maintaining accurate follow-up records. 

- Strong attention to detail when documenting patient conversations, insurance information, and scheduling updates. 

- Ability to handle confidential patient information appropriately and follow HIPAA requirements. 

- Hands-on experience with dental insurance verification, eligibility checks, and benefit confirmation. 

- Experience with outbound lead follow-up, appointment setting, or supporting a U.S.-based dental or medical practice remotely. 

 Nice to Have: 

- Familiarity with dental practice management software. 

- Experience using RingCentral or another web-based VoIP phone system..

- 
 Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor

- 
 Workplace: Remote

- 
 Compensation: USD $1,000 - $1,300 / month

- 
 Schedule: Monday through Friday for either 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM or 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM Pacific Time.

 About the Role
 As a Bilingual Dental Virtual Assistant, you’ll take ownership of high-volume patient outreach, insurance verification, appointment scheduling, and follow-up across both dental offices. Outbound calling is the core of this position, so you should genuinely enjoy speaking with patients and be comfortable spending much of your workday on the phone.
 Your immediate priorities will include verifying insurance, scheduling six-month recall appointments, following up with patients, and completing postoperative care calls. As you build trust and demonstrate strong performance, you’ll have the opportunity to take on marketing lead follow-up and potentially grow into treatment coordination or broader dental administrative responsibilities.
 Responsibilities

- Own a consistent outbound calling workflow for patient recalls, appointment confirmations, postoperative follow-ups, and other priority outreach.

- Verify dental insurance eligibility and coverage before appointments by contacting insurance providers and patients as needed.

- Follow up with patients to collect missing or incomplete insurance information and keep records accurate and up to date.

- Re-engage patients who are due or overdue for six-month checkups and cleanings and help convert outreach into scheduled appointments.

- Confirm upcoming appointments and coordinate accurate scheduling across both dental office locations.

- Complete postoperative care calls, document patient feedback, and escalate clinical concerns to the appropriate dental team.

- Maintain clear, accurate call notes, insurance verification results, appointment updates, and follow-up records in the practice’s systems.

- Track outbound call activity, talk time, completed follow-ups, and other performance expectations consistently.

- Coordinate closely with office managers and administrative staff to keep patient communication organized across both practices.

- After training, follow up with prospective patients generated through Meta/Facebook campaigns, answer general questions, and help convert interested leads into attended appointments

 Requirements

 Must-Have: 

- Fluent spoken English and Spanish with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically with patients. 

- Experience in a dental, medical, patient coordination, reception, virtual assistant, or healthcare administrative environment. 

- Confidence performing high-volume outbound calling throughout the workday. 

- Experience scheduling patient appointments and maintaining accurate follow-up records. 

- Strong attention to detail when documenting patient conversations, insurance information, and scheduling updates. 

- Ability to handle confidential patient information appropriately and follow HIPAA requirements. 

- Hands-on experience with dental insurance verification, eligibility checks, and benefit confirmation. 

- Experience with outbound lead follow-up, appointment setting, or supporting a U.S.-based dental or medical practice remotely. 

 Nice to Have: 

- Familiarity with dental practice management software. 

- Experience using RingCentral or another web-based VoIP phone system..

 Global Dimensions, LLC is a HUBZone-certified, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) headquartered in Fredericksburg, Virginia. We provide mission-critical professional and technical services supporting federal government and defense operations.

 As a Business Operations & Support Specialist , you will assist with administrative functions, business research, project coordination, and other corporate support activities.

 Assignments will be based on individual qualifications, experience, interests, and organizational needs. Opportunities may include supporting Business Development, Human Resources, Recruiting, Program Management, Contracts, and Corporate Operations .

 This position is ideal for individuals seeking flexible, part-time remote employment while developing valuable administrative, organizational, and business support skills.

 Conduct online research related to federal contracting opportunities, government agencies, industry trends, prospective business partners, and professional contacts .

 Organize and maintain business development information, research findings, spreadsheets, and internal databases .

 Participate in virtual meetings, team communications, and special projects as assigned.

 Prepare research summaries, checklists, progress reports, and other business support materials .

 Perform additional administrative and operational support duties based on qualifications and company needs.

 Ability to maintain accurate records, communicate progress, and handle company information professionally and confidentially.

 Exposure to government contracting, recruiting, human resources, business development, or project management .

 College students, recent graduates, military spouses, retirees, and individuals seeking supplemental part-time employment are encouraged to apply. Previous federal contracting experience is not required for general business support assignments.

 This is a fully remote, part-time position requiring approximately 10 hours per week , with flexible scheduling Monday through Friday.

 Employees will work using company-approved communication and information systems and maintain regular contact with an assigned supervisor or project lead.

Job Title: Bilingual Medical Virtual Assistant — Pediatric Therapy 
 Position Type: Full-Time 
 Work Hours: 7:30 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time
 Work Days: Monday to Friday
 Salary: $6–$7 per hour, depending on experience
 Job Code: VC-LT
 Workplace: Remote
 Preferred Candidate Location: LATAM 
 About the Client & Role
 Our client is a pediatric therapy provider serving children and families throughout Orlando, Florida. The practice provides specialized services, including Speech Therapy, Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, and Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA). 
 They are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Bilingual Medical Virtual Assistant — Pediatric Therapy to support scheduling, billing, insurance coordination, patient communication, Excel-based tracking, and daily administrative operations.
 This is a fast-paced role that requires fluent Spanish and English communication, strong Excel skills, excellent follow-through, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities throughout the workday.
 Scope of Work / Responsibilities
 Patient Calls, Scheduling & Communication

- Handle a high volume of patient calls, referrals, scheduling requests, and general inquiries.

- Schedule, confirm, reschedule, and follow up on patient appointments.

- Track patient schedules, therapist availability, cancellations, and open scheduling needs.

- Coordinate schedules between patients, therapists, and administrative staff.

- Maintain accurate records of patient calls, appointments, and communications.

- Follow up on unresolved scheduling or patient communication items.

 GroupMe Parent Communication & Tracking

- Actively monitor and track parent messages through GroupMe throughout the entire workday.

- Respond to or route parent questions, scheduling requests, cancellations, and concerns appropriately.

- Ensure parent messages are acknowledged and handled in a timely manner.

- Track outstanding parent requests and follow up until resolved.

- Communicate important parent updates to the appropriate therapist, BCBA, front desk staff, or management team.

- Update schedules and tracking systems when changes are made based on parent communication.

 Insurance, Claims & Credentialing Support

- Communicate with insurance companies regarding eligibility, benefits, claims, coverage, and authorization requirements.

- Process or assist with insurance claims and prior authorizations.

- Track insurance approvals, authorized units or hours, expiration dates, and service limitations.

- Assist with credentialing-related documentation and insurance requirements.

- Follow up with insurance companies regarding outstanding claims, authorizations, or documentation.

 Billing, Unit Tracking & Schedule Coordination

- Convert therapy units based on CPT codes into billable hours for scheduling and billing purposes.

- Understand varying unit durations, including 15-minute and 30-minute units.

- Review therapist schedules to ensure required billable hours are being met.

- Identify scheduling gaps and assist with maximizing therapist schedules.

- Track and report billable hours accurately for insurance and internal records.

- Maintain accurate authorization and billing information to help prevent scheduling beyond approved hours.

 Excel-Based Tracking & Data Management

- Create and maintain spreadsheets for patient schedules, insurance authorizations, billing hours, therapist productivity, and other operational needs.

- Use Excel formulas to calculate billable hours, convert units into hours, and organize data.

- Use sorting, filtering, formulas, and other Excel functions confidently.

- Maintain organized, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets.

- Review data for errors and discrepancies before submitting or reporting information.

- Assist with creating reports and tracking outstanding administrative items.

 Administrative & Operational Support

- Maintain and update patient records while protecting confidential healthcare information.

- Provide general administrative support, including document processing and patient correspondence.

- Assist with remote patient monitoring or healthcare coordination when needed.

- Maintain internal tracking spreadsheets and administrative records.

- Assist with scheduling interviews and coordinating applicant availability when requested.

- Support management with additional administrative projects and responsibilities as assigned.

 Tools You’ll Use

- Microsoft Excel

- GroupMe

- TheraBill or similar medical scheduling/billing system

- Medical scheduling and billing platforms

- Patient communication and tracking systems

- Other administrative, insurance, and reporting tools as needed

 Requirements
 Experience Requirements

- 
 Healthcare Administrative Experience: Required . Candidates must have at least 1 year of experience in a medical office, healthcare administration, medical billing, medical scheduling, patient coordination, or a similar role.

Who We Are
 Brolly Labs dba CatalyzeX , is a business process outsourcing specialist that combines process expertise with top offshore talent, delivering the best value outcomes for its clients.
 As an incubator of cutting-edge services, software, and AI brands, we partner with forward-thinking firms in e-commerce, legal, healthcare, and software sectors to deliver human-centric solutions that truly make a difference.
 What You'll Do
 You'll be the first point of contact for potential clients reaching out to a US-based law firm, gathering case details with care and accuracy and making sure every caller feels heard.

- Handle inbound and outbound calls with potential clients in both English and Spanish.

- Gather case details accurately and enter them into the firm's intake system or CRM.

- Screen inquiries against case criteria and route qualified leads to the legal team.

- Schedule consultations and follow up with clients by phone, text, and email.

- Support callers who may be going through a stressful time with patience and empathy.

- Keep records clean, complete, and confidential.

 Who You Are
 We're looking for candidates who meet the following criteria:

- Fully bilingual: native or fluent Spanish with strong, professional English (written and spoken).

- Prior experience in legal intake, call center, customer service, or a related client-facing role.

- A clear, empathetic communicator who stays calm under pressure.

- Detail-oriented with fast, accurate typing and strong documentation habits.

- Personal injury or law firm intake experience.

- Experience with CRM or case management systems.

 RAM: Minimum 8 GB (16 GB preferred)
 ﻿Noise-canceling headset
 ﻿Power and internet backup required
 Rates and Expectations

- Work Setup: Remote

 Position: Sales Patient Coordinator (High Value Cases)

 Company: Medical Departures Inc.
 Department: Medical Team

- USD 800 - 1,100 per month + Commission + Performance Bonuses

- 100% Remote — LATAM / APAC / EU

- Full-time Contractor | 5 days/week | 10 hours/day included lunch break l Shifts

 About Us
 Medical Departures Inc. is the world’s largest online platform for booking trusted global doctors and dentists — with 10,000+ professionals across 6,000+ clinics in 30 countries.
 We help patients find high-quality, affordable care abroad through our platforms:DentalDepartures.comandMedicalDepartures.com.
 Our fully remote team of 36+ professionals spans Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa — united by one mission: to make medical travel simpler, safer, and smarter.
 About the Role
 We are hiring high-performance sales professionals who can convert complex, high-value dental cases ($3,000–$25,000+) into confirmed and attended bookings.
 This is NOT short-cycle commodity sales.
 This is:

- Long follow-up cycles

- Emotional trust-based selling

- High-ticket consultation sales

- Travel-readiness qualification

- Attendance-driven execution

 You will be responsible not just for booking — but for ensuring patients SHOW UP.
 If you thrive in structured sales funnels, disciplined follow-up systems, and high accountability environments — this role is for you.
 What You’ll Do

 Big-Ticket Conversion (Primary Focus) 

- Convert inbound and outbound high-value leads into qualified, deposit-ready bookings.

- Execute structured follow-up sequences (minimum required touchpoints).

- Handle objections around:

- Price

- Travel

- Fear

- Clinic credibility

- Position treatment packages, brochures, and custom quotes professionally.

- Drive patient commitment toward deposit and confirmed attendance.

 Long-Cycle Follow-Up Discipline 

- Maintain consistent follow-up across sales cycles.

- No lead left untouched.

- Recycle dormant big-ticket leads strategically.

- Avoid premature “Not Interested” tagging without qualification attempts.

 Pre-Attendance Qualification 

 Before a booking is accepted as confirmed, you must validate:

- Treatment intent

- Financial readiness

- Timeline commitment

 You will work with Team Leaders to ensure bookings are not soft or forecast-inflating.

 Attendance Ownership 

- Proactively manage pre-VIP communication.

- Confirm travel details, deposits, and readiness.

- Reduce no-show rates.

- Protect clinic relationships by ensuring booking integrity.

 Pipeline & CRM Discipline 

- Maintain 95%+ CRM accuracy.

- 
 Track every stage:

 Lead → Contact → Qualified → Booked → Attended

- No ghosting, no abandoned big-ticket opportunities.

- Follow reassignment and performance-based distribution rules.

 Performance Expectations 

 This is a performance-driven role.
 You will be measured on:

- Big-ticket conversion rate

- Follow-up compliance

- Booking quality

- Attendance rate

- Revenue generated

- CRM accuracy

 Top performers receive:

- Priority access to high-value leads

- Promotion eligibility (Senior / Closer / Team Lead)

 Underperformance leads to reduced big-ticket allocation.
 Team Collaboration

- Join coaching sessions, performance reviews, and weekly team syncs.

- Participate in sales challenges and contribute to team targets.

 Ready to Join the Global Dental Revolution?
 Be part of a team that helps patients worldwide access affordable, high-quality care.
Apply now help us build the world’s largest global medical marketplace.

 Requirements

 Who You Are:

- >5 years of sales experience (ideally in healthcare, travel or remote B2C sales)

- Proven experience closing $3,000+ ticket deals

- Comfortable handling long-cycle sales

- Disciplined follow-up executor

- Comfortable being audited on performance

- Resilient under rejection and objections

- Fluent English (written + verbal)

- Confident using CRM systems (Zoho, Salesforce, etc.) and multitasking across tools (chat, phone, email)

- Comfortable working weekends (Saturday-Sunday) and flexible shifts

- Reliable, organized, and proactive in a fully remote setup

 Strongly Preferred 

- Medical / dental tourism experience

- Experience selling packages or bundled services

 Benefits

 What We Offer: 

- Guarantee base: Fixed monthly salary paid in USD

- Commission: 5% of all earned commissions

- Bonuses: Tiered monthly rewards ($100–$1,000) + team bonuses

- Incentives: Top performers win all-inclusive trips to global destinations

 The Role 
As a Spanish consecutive medical interpreter, your primary responsibility is to facilitate communication between healthcare providers and patients who speak Spanish . You will interpret over the phone (OPI) and via video (VRI), working remotely on an hourly shift program in the EST time zone.
 What You'll Do

- 
 Accurately interpret medical terminology, diagnoses, treatments, and other information between Spanish-speaking patients and healthcare providers, including doctors, nurses, and other medical staff

- 
 Provide cultural mediation , helping patients understand the healthcare system and navigate it effectively, and helping providers understand cultural differences that may affect patient care

- 
 Maintain patient confidentiality and adhere to ethical standards in the interpretation profession

- 
 Document interpretation services provided , including date, time, duration, and type of interpretation

- 
 Stay current on medical terminology and healthcare practices to ensure accurate interpretation over time

 What You'll Bring

- Fluency in Spanish and English 

- Experience in medical interpretation or translation 

- Knowledge of medical terminology and familiarity with the healthcare system 

- Good communication skills, cultural sensitivity, and the ability to work well under pressure 

 Technical Requirements

- 
 15 Mbps download and upload internet speed , USB headset compulsory

- 
 A capable PC , 5th generation or higher, minimum 8GB RAM, LAN (Ethernet) connection

- HD webcam 

 Growth 
You will build a strong foundation in professional medical interpretation across both OPI and VRI formats, with ongoing QA feedback and attendance-based incentives, and room to grow into higher-volume or specialized interpretation work as you build your track record.
 Compensation and Terms

- 
 USD 6 per hour , hourly shift program, EST time zone

- 
 This is an independent contractor position , paid monthly via Payoneer only

- 
 Paid training : 80 hours over 10 business days, paid at half the agreed rate, paid regardless of onboarding date provided you pass the assessment and start working

- 
 Attendance and QA bonuses as part of the incentive structure

- Final assessment conducted through LanguageStat; on passing, you'll receive portal credentials from the client, with platform training and guidance provided by the IT team

- 
 No leave during the first month , except emergencies with prior supervisor approval

 Job Details

- Employment type: Independent Contractor

- Workplace: Remote

- Hours: Hourly shift program, EST time zone

- Vacancies: 20

 Who Can Apply 
This role is open to candidates based in Latin America and Mexico, Colombia, Bolivia, Argentina, Peru, Chile, Ecuador, Guatemala, Costa Rica, Panama, Dominican Republic, Uruguay, Paraguay, El Salvador, Honduras, and Nicaragua.
 How to Apply 
Apply with your updated Resume and a Cover / Motivation letter . We only move forward with candidates who clearly show us what they bring to the table.

 Video Editing & Storytelling

- Edit short- and long-form videos using footage captured during on-location shoots.

- Transform interviews, patient testimonials, scripted presentations, and educational content into polished videos.

- Select compelling moments from raw footage and use pacing, shot selection, and B-roll to create engaging stories.

 Social Media & Content Repurposing

- Repurpose longer videos into short-form clips for social media and digital marketing.

 Motion Graphics & Visual Enhancements

- Create basic motion graphics, including animated text, lower thirds, titles, transitions, and overlays.

- Incorporate visual enhancements that support storytelling and brand consistency.

- Organize source footage, project files, and editing assets for team accessibility.

- Export deliverables according to required codecs, file formats, resolutions, frame rates, and aspect ratios.

- Troubleshoot editing challenges involving lighting, audio quality, and limited usable footage.

- Identify and communicate production issues early.

- Incorporate feedback efficiently while managing deadlines across multiple client projects.

 Qualifications
 Experience

- Hands-on experience editing short- and long-form video content using professional editing software.

- Experience transforming interviews, testimonials, presentations, and B-roll into polished, client-ready videos.

- Experience editing content for social media, websites, and digital marketing channels.

- Experience performing color correction, audio cleanup, and basic motion graphics.

- Experience managing video editing projects independently from footage review through final delivery.

- Experience with advanced video cleanup techniques, including flicker reduction, masking, face refinement, or video noise reduction, is preferred.

- Experience with dental marketing, patient acquisition, or educational healthcare content is a plus.

 Skills

- Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro , or similar professional video editing software.

We need someone like you to make good decisions, debug thorny issues, and build us a future-proof platform that can withstand this scale. Our small but mighty infrastructure team has set up a secure and simple environment (we don’t believe in spinning up a new service unless necessary!) for our growing product team to build in. -

-

 We’re looking for someone who can build systems that an engineer would like to work with: mature and boring but open-minded and approachable. We have to balance reliability with flexibility. Software and its availability are now mission critical to almost every working professional. To be a platform engineer in today’s world, you have to be extremely comfortable evaluating risk, those you take and those others take.

 What We’re Building

 As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us better at what we do. When we started Ashby, we saw the opposite with Talent Acquisition software. Recruiting teams were leveling up how they did their work, but instead of software meeting this new standard, it held them back.

 About Proof 

 Launched in 2018, Proof is a national platform for service of process supporting thousands of law firms across the United States. We connect law firms with process servers and enable electronic court filing through a modern, technology-driven platform — automating document ingestion, compliance, real-time job matching, and integrations with leading legal software. Today, Proof delivers over 60,000 documents per month through a network of ~2,000 contracted process servers.

 A Dispatch Specialist I is the front line of Proof's marketplace. You negotiate fairly with both clients and servers and learn from every job outcome.  What you'll do

- Own a territory. Become the subject-matter expert on the operational requirements (e.g., regional licensing and coverage rules) for the regions you're assigned.

- Communicate with clients. Handle client conversations by phone and email, negotiating the path that works best for everyone.

- Negotiate fair pricing. Set prices that work for the server and the business, and hold the line when it counts.

- Document everything. Keep records of client and server communications and the decisions you made on the job.

- Improve as you go. Spot inefficiencies in your workflow. Share pricing and network gaps with the broader team to strengthen the market.

- Support your peers. Help teammates solve problems when they ask. Contribute to an overall team that runs better because you're on it.

- Use data to learn. Use data and dashboards to track your own performance, identify trends, and improve your decisions and workflows.

 Who you are

- A customer-oriented communicator. You're respectful and kind, even when things are hard or moving fast.

- Composed under pressure. Tense conversations don't rattle you. You stay calm and professional.

- Detail-oriented and organized. You don't let things slip through the cracks. Your task queue stays clean. You write clear notes that support your decisions.

- A negotiator. You can hold a price, explain the why, and find creative paths forward when the first option doesn't work.

- Data-curious. You're comfortable opening a dashboard, asking a question, and using the answer to improve your work.

- A team player. You help peers when they ask. You bring ideas to your manager. You make the team better.

- Adaptable. You're comfortable in a fast-paced, changing environment, and you pick up new tools and procedures quickly.

 Qualifications

- Strong verbal and written communication skills.

- Comfortable making outbound phone calls every day.

- Experience or natural ability building trust-based relationships, especially with independent contractors or other partners.

- Excellent time management and organizational skills; able to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.

- Comfortable in fast-paced environments with frequent change.

- Proficiency in MacOS and Google Suite (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, Slides).

- Rapid learner — able to embrace new technology and new procedures quickly.

 Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree.

- Experience in dispatch, logistics, or operations.

- Experience on a marketplace or gig economy platform.

- Familiarity with business intelligence tools for self-serve analytics.

 Compensation & Location

- Eligible for company bonus plan

 Benefits

- Flexible Time Off (FTO) and paid holidays

- Company equipment provided

About Us: 

 Spreedly is the Intelligent Payments Platform for businesses that want to own their payments strategy. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, we give merchants, platforms, and fintechs a single API to connect to 150+ payment gateways and 40+ payment methods across 100+ countries, along with the intelligence to decide where every transaction should go. We're vendor-agnostic by design. Our customers choose their providers, keep their payment data portable, and never have to rebuild their stack to adopt something new.

 Payments are getting more complex, not less. Every new market, payment method, fraud tool, and now every AI agent checking out on a shopper's behalf adds another integration and another decision. Spreedly turns that complexity into an advantage. Our PCI Level 1 vault keeps cards and network tokens portable across providers. Smart routing and retries recover revenue lost to avoidable declines. Fraud and 3DS tools plug in with a single API call. And our payments intelligence turns transaction data into decisions merchants can act on. As agentic commerce moves from experiment to real sales channel, we're building the infrastructure that lets merchants accept agent-initiated payments through the providers they already trust.

 For the people who work here, that means hard technical problems at real scale, billions of dollars in annual transactions, at a moment when the rules of commerce are being rewritten. If you want ownership and work that shows up directly in your customers' revenue, you'll fit right in.

 About the Role 

 Spreedly is looking for a Support Engineer to take on our most complex customer issues and bridge the gap between support and engineering. You'll go beyond identifying a bug: you'll investigate where it occurs, explain its impact, and give engineering the evidence and technical context needed to resolve it.

 You'll join an international support team that serves customers, partners, prospects, and internal colleagues. Our Tier 1 team provides round-the-clock support, while Tier 2 handles deeper technical investigations. This role brings additional engineering depth to that work, particularly in troubleshooting SDKs and complex payments integrations.

 This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll work directly on difficult cases while helping teammates develop their technical skills. We also want this hire to help lay the foundation for a potential Tier 3 support function. That expansion and any future team leadership role are subject to leadership approval, rather than guaranteed next steps.

 We expect roughly 60% of your time to focus on complex customer tickets, most of them from our top-tier accounts. The remaining time will involve retrospectives, customer advocacy, cross-functional projects, and coaching.

 Responsibilities

- 
 Own complex technical investigations, particularly for our top-tier customer accounts. Read and navigate source code, analyze logs, and inspect API and SDK behavior to pinpoint issues.

- 
 Reproduce customer issues in test environments so findings are confirmed before they reach engineering.

- 
 Build clear, actionable engineering escalations that explain the problem, where it occurs, and potential approaches to resolving it, with engineering retaining final decisions on changes.

- 
 Bring SDK troubleshooting expertise to support for our Checkout SDK and share that knowledge across the team in collaboration with engineering.

- 
 Help manage incidents and keep customers informed, translating technical findings into clear explanations and advocating for their needs across departments.

- 
 Identify recurring patterns across cases, lead retrospectives, and turn findings into improvements that prevent repeat issues and reduce prolonged back-and-forth with engineering.

- 
 Improve documentation, share investigation techniques, and coach support teammates through unfamiliar technical problems.

- 
 Take ownership of cross-functional projects, from defining the problem through completing and rolling out the work.

- 

 Candidate Requirements

- 
 A foundation in software development through professional experience, coding education, or another hands-on path, with the ability to investigate code and explain technical findings.

- 
 Experience troubleshooting SDKs and working with APIs, including understanding how integrations behave in a web environment.

- 
 Customer-facing technical experience and the ability to communicate clearly with customers during complex or prolonged investigations.

- 
 The ability to coach others and lead work without formal authority. You don't need a previous management title, but you should be able to guide teammates and collaborate effectively with engineering.

- 
 Independent problem-solving and project ownership: you can work through ambiguity, move an investigation forward, and know when to bring others in.

- 
 Payments experience is strongly preferred because it will help you ramp quick

It was the system that failed: the way information moved, decisions got routed, and fragmented teams and data turned solvable problems into tragedy.

 I started Anima to change that.

 Our mission is human wellbeing, and we believe personalised medicine will transform it. Our founding insight is that getting there requires a system that learns continuously from care and its outcomes, optimising for human wellbeing. Building that learning engine is the opportunity at the heart of Anima.

 We're now in 1,000+ clinics across 5 product lines, serving more than 25% of the UK population. We are cash flow positive, growing fast, and have a tight crew of ~45 people who care deeply for each other and the mission. Everyone has real ownership and a voice in decisions.

 Multiple trillion-dollar companies will be built in healthcare over the next two decades. We intend to be one of them. 

 If you want to work on problems where the stakes are high, you belong at Anima. Your work here will save lives.

 -- Shun

 £65k–£90k base, plus equity 
 UK remote, UK working hours, with occasional UK customer visits 

 The role

 Help GP practices make a confident start with Anima.

 Last quarter, we onboarded 131 practices. We’re building a dedicated Implementation team to support that growth, and you’ll be one of its first members.

 You’ll own each implementation from kick-off through go-live and early support, helping practice teams build the skills and confidence to use Anima independently. You’ll also help shape how we implement: improving workflows, developing training and building a playbook that works across hundreds of practices.

 What you’ll do

- 
 Own implementations from start to finish. Coordinate kick-off, configuration and go-live, aiming to get most practices live within their first week.

- 
 Make Anima work for each practice. Understand how their team operates and configure workflows around their needs.

- 
 Teach people to use it confidently. Run clear, practical training for clinicians and practice teams, adapting your approach to different levels of technical confidence.

- 
 Build confidence beyond go-live. Develop practice super users, provide 1–2 weeks of hypercare and hand over cleanly to Support and Customer Success.

- 
 Make great implementation repeatable. Create reusable training and group webinars. Use feedback from customers, Support and CS to solve recurring problems at their source.

 What you’ll bring

- 
 SaaS experience. You’ve worked directly with customers on a SaaS product in onboarding, implementation or training.

- 
 Strong teaching and communication skills. You can make something unfamiliar feel manageable and check that people can put it into practice.

- 
 Patience and adaptability. You respond thoughtfully when someone is struggling or their priorities change.

- 
 Practical problem-solving. You learn products quickly and can work out why a workflow isn’t delivering the intended result.

- 
 Ownership and organisation. You can keep several implementations moving while making the next steps clear to everyone involved.

 Healthcare experience isn’t required—we’ll help you learn primary care. Experience creating training videos, guides or webinars would be useful.

 What we offer

 Anima should be where you do your life’s best work. We support that with:

- 
 Time off: 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 UK public holidays, with flexible additional time off.

- 
 Health cover: private medical, dental, vision and mental health insurance.

- 
 Parental leave: 12 weeks’ maternity leave at full pay, rising to 24 weeks after two years; 4 weeks’ paternity leave at full pay.

- 
 Pension: 4% employer contributions, with salary sacrifice and 100% of the employer National Insurance savings passed on to you.

- 
 Learning: £1,000 annual budget for your development.

- 
 Fitness: gym subscription matching up to £50 per month.

- 
 Equipment: a high-spec MacBook and a home office budget.

- 
 Time together: two full-team off-sites each year, previous destinations include Mykonos and Mexico.

- 
 Farringdon office: a beautiful new London HQ, with most of the team together at least twice a week.

 Everyone is welcome at Anima. We strongly believe in building a diverse and inclusive team. If you’re excited by our mission and believe you could do this work well, we’d love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn’t match every point above. If adjustments would help you participate fully in the interview process, please let us know.

Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

 We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

 Please Note: This role will be employed and onboarded by a third party partner of Fastly in compliance with local laws and on assignment with Fastly.

 Director of Partnerships - Brazil

 About the Role

 The Global Partnerships team is seeking a seasoned professional to drive the strategy for our partner ecosystem in Brazil. As the Director, Partnerships, you will be a critical leader responsible for transforming how we engage, enable, and scale our regional partners, including Value-Added Resellers (VARs), Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), and Referral Partners. This is a builder’s role. You will be an integral part of an emerging LATAM team at Fastly, working alongside colleagues in Brazil to build our next emerging market through strategic, value-driven partner alliances.

 Your core mission will be to establish our platform as the foundational engine for partner growth in the region, enabling our partners to launch, sell, and support next-generation, margin-rich services built entirely on our modern platform. This role is about developing a high-impact, channel-first motion that drives recurring revenue, competitive differentiation, and long-term customer success for the partner. You will own the executive relationship, strategic vision, and overall business outcome for our key partners in Brazil.

 Responsibilities

 Ecosystem Strategy & Recruitment (The "Hunter" Motion)

- Market Mapping: Identify and recruit top-tier MSPs, MSSPs, and Systems Integrators in Brazil who specialize in Cloud Security, Content Delivery, and Edge Compute.

- Vertical Alignment: Target partners specifically equipped to serve our high-performing verticals, ensuring they understand Fastly's competitive advantage over legacy providers.

- Deal Structuring: Structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements that support various partner models (Resell, Managed Service, Referral, Distributor and Cloud Marketplaces), ensuring mutual profitability and long-term alignment.

 Partner Growth & Co-Innovation (The "Farmer" Motion)

- Joint Business Planning (JBP): Lead executive-level planning sessions with key partners to align their service portfolios with Fastly’s product roadmap.

- Service Creation: Collaborate with partners to build unique, "Powered by Fastly" offerings—such as Managed WAF, Advanced Edge Compute solutions, or Observability platforms—that generate new recurring revenue streams for them.

- Executive Alignment: Own the C-level relationships (CEO, CTO, CISO) within our partner organizations, acting as their trusted advisor and executive sponsor within Fastly.

 Go-to-Market & Enablement

- Sales Activation: Collaborate with Partner Marketing to create scalable sales playbooks and GTM programs that drive consumption within the partner’s field sales teams.

- Enablement: Ensure partner technical and sales teams are fully certified and capable of positioning Fastly’s full portfolio—moving beyond basic delivery to advanced security and compute solutions.

- Pipeline Management: oversee the partner pipeline, ensuring accurate forecasting and healthy deal flow across the region.

 Advocacy & Leadership

- Internal Evangelist: Serve as the "Voice of Brazilian Partners" internally, synthesizing market feedback and competitive intelligence (specifically vs. legacy CDN/Security competitors) to inform Fastly’s Product and Sales leadership.

 Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or a related field.

 Work Hours: 

- This position will require you to be available during core business hours. 

 Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements: 

 This position is a remote role and open to candidates residing in the following locations: 

- Brazil

 This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager.

 AI Statement

 To ensure a fair and equitable interview process for everyone, the use of AI technologies—including real-time transcription tools, automated scripts, AI copilots, or external assistants—is strictly prohibited during the interview process unless explicitly authorized by the company in advance. Unauthorized use of AI tools may result in disqualification.

 ________________________

Hello! 

 I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby . I’m excited to share that we’re hiring a Product Support Engineer in EMEA 🎉 

 We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being one of the first Support Engineers across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process.

 Not sure which Support role is right for you? 

 We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles. 

- 
 Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes.

- 
 Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes.

 Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review.

 About the role 

 Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect.

 You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As an early Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team.

 What you’ll own 

- 
 Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved.

- 
 Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues.

- 
 Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers.

- 
 Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback.

- 
 Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement.

- 
 Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team.

- 
 Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence.

 You should apply if: 

- 
 You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior.

- 
 You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes.

- 
 You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly.

- 
 You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones.

- 
 You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design.

- 
 You want to be an early technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team.

 You should not apply if: 

- 
 You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership.

- 
 Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deplo

About Pleo 

 Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

 The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

 Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

 About the role: 

 We're looking for a Digital Onboarding Solutions Specialist to join our Digital Onboarding Solutions team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help customers who have got stuck while onboarding themselves onto Pleo, unblock them, and make sure they get to a successful first spend. You'll also help us find and fix the friction that causes these blockers in the first place. If you enjoy solving real problems for real people, and you care about making onboarding work better for everyone, then this is the opportunity for you!

 Who you'll be working with and reporting to 

 You'll report to our Manager, Onboarding and work closely with the Digital Onboarding Solutions Manager. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to getting every new customer to a smooth, successful start on Pleo. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across Product, Growth, Sales, Support and RevOps to remove friction for our customers.

 What you'll be doing 

 As a Digital Onboarding Solutions Specialist, you will:

- 
 Monitor escalation channels, handle live chats during coverage hours, diagnose blockers, and agree next steps with customers.

- 
 Pick up Freshdesk tickets raised outside live chat hours, reply by email the next business morning, and offer a call when needed.

- 
 Schedule and run calls with customers who are blocked during self-onboarding and have escalated via chat or email.

- 
 Coordinate internally on specialist escalation consultations and take ownership of seeing each case through to resolution.

- 
 Record the stage, blocker and outcome for every account, and run 1–2 week progress checks to keep customers moving.

- 
 Work closely with the Digital Onboarding Solutions Manager to improve our processes by flagging inefficiencies and proposing fixes.

- 
 Run proactive outreach on stalled accounts before they churn or give up.

 What you bring 

 You'll thrive in this role if you have:

- 
 Experience in customer support, customer success, onboarding or another role where you help people get unstuck quickly.

- 
 A clear, structured approach to diagnosing problems: you ask the right questions, find the real blocker, and agree a next step.

- 
 Confidence running calls with customers, including those who are frustrated or short on time. • Strong attention to detail and the discipline to record stage, blocker and outcome consistently.

- 
 A continuous improvement mindset, and the willingness to raise inefficiencies and help fix them with others.

- 
 Comfort working across different channels (live chat, email, calls) and managing your own queue.

- 
 Working hours are 9am–5pm.

 Why is this role a good fit for you 

 This role is a good fit for you if:

- 
 You get satisfaction from turning a stuck customer into a happy one.

- 
 You like spotting patterns, asking why something keeps going wrong, and doing something about it.

- 
 You are organised and enjoy owning a caseload from start to finish.

- 
 This role is not a good fit for you if:

- 
 You prefer to work without regular contact with customers.

- 
 You find it hard to switch between many open cases and channels in a single day.

 How you'll develop in this role 

 In your first several weeks at Pleo, you'll:

- 
 Build deep knowledge of Pleo's product and the most common onboarding blockers, so you can resolve cases faster.

- 
 Take ownership of your own caseload and proactive outreach to stalled accounts.

- 
 Work with the Digital Onboarding Solutions Manager and cross-functional partners to improve a process or flow that is blocking customers. We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on more complex escalations, stepping into a Team Lead role, or building new skills in onboarding design, product, marketing, and digital funnel building.

Proper AI is an AI-first accounting service built for property managers and real estate operators. 

 By combining automation, technology, and a global team of accounting experts, we deliver faster, more accurate financial operations at scale.

 We’re a team of builders, problem-solvers, and operators from around the world, working together to modernize one of the most critical functions in real estate.

 Learn more at Proper.ai 

 We’re seeking an Accountant I to join our team. 

 We are looking for someone with great attention to detail to work with a team of 8-10 accountants and help extract and enter accounting data accurately. Your data entry skills will support accounting operations. At Proper, we take pride in delivering amazing results, communicating effectively, and growing our business and this role will be instrumental in continuing that trend. 

 If that sounds like you and you’re excited by the idea of joining a world-class team that’s passionate about growing together, we look forward to hearing from you. 

 Proper is a San Francisco-based tech startup. This pisition will be based remotely in Mexico. 

 Role and Responsabilities

- Work with a team of 8-10 people to extract and input accounting-related information in a fast-paced environment.

- Communication with clients on a daily basis via email. 

 Accounts Payable 

- Posting and processing journal entries to ensure all business transactions are recorded.

- Assist in the processing of balance sheets, income statements, and other financial statements according to legal and company accounting and financial guidelines.

- Update financial data in databases to ensure that information will be accurate and immediately available when needed.

- Adhere to standard operating procedures to ensure an optimal level of timeliness.

 Bank Account Reconciliation 

- Responsible for pulling bank statements and matching all transactions into the software for bank reconciliations.

- Responsible for following the protocols & SOPs established by the company to ensure quality in daily operations.

- Identify and flag unmatched and stale dated transactions (checks remain uncleared for 90 days or longer) to the team General Accountant for follow-up.

 Accounts Receivable 

- Perform specific low-complexity activities for the manual rent invoice posting/cash application processes.

 Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 

- Minimum of 6 months in AP/AR roles. 

- Good understanding of accounting and financial reporting principles and practices

- Intermediate knowledge of English, at minimum.

 Preferred Experience (not mandatory)

- Experience in transitioning or integrating SSC methodologies into a corporate environment.

- Experience working in or with a Shared Service Center.

- Familiarity with major accounting software such as Quickbooks, Yardi, AppFolio, etc. 

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

- Attention to detail & ability to manage multiple tasks.

- Strong team player with the ability to work independently.

- Dealing in a fast-paced startup environment is a plus

- Software experience: Jira, Hubspot

About Supabase

 Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

 About the Role

 We are hiring a AI Platform Engineer to build the execution layer for Supabase's internal AI systems.

 Supabase is building an AI-native internal operating system: a common way of working across the company where AI carries a meaningful share of the operational load rather than sitting alongside it as an assistant. We are standing up a new central team to build those systems, enable the teams, and embed AI operations throughout the organization. You are the engineer on that team.

 The execution layer is yours. You will build the platform that actually runs agents: an event-triggered queue, a headless model-agnostic runtime, durable state so work survives a restart, a human review gate, atomic rollback, and full logging of every prompt, tool call and decision so any run can be reconstructed. You will build the evaluation layer that makes any of it trustworthy, because an agent that cannot be measured cannot be trusted with anything beyond reading. And you will build the agents themselves, across everything from executive reporting down to a layer of agents that watch the platform and improve it.

 This is a governance-heavy environment by design, and that is the interesting part of the problem. Agents are risk-tiered from read-only internal data through to external-facing output, with review depth, evaluation requirements and human approval scaling by tier. Some capabilities are permanently off limits: an agent may read and report, it may carry a human-authored update into a system of record once a human consents, and it may initiate contact within a strict budget, but it may never autonomously write a commitment (an owner, a due date, a status) into a shared work system. Your job is to make that structurally impossible rather than merely forbidden.

 You will be the only engineer on this platform. You will close open architecture decisions yourself, own the infrastructure end to end, and instrument the system so it reports its own return.

 What You'll Be Responsible For

 In this role, you'll:

- 
 Ship the agent platform to production. An event-triggered queue, a headless model-agnostic runtime (choosing the runtime is an open decision you will close), durable state that survives a failed run, a human review gate, atomic rollback, and complete run logging in the warehouse.

- 
 Own the evaluation layer, and switch on the gate that depends on it. Golden suites with behavioral assertions rather than intuition, judge criteria with a written rubric, safety cases that must pass on every run, and a CI gate that blocks a regression from merging. This is the precondition for every agent that does anything beyond read internal data.

- 
 Build and register the agent portfolio. Reporting, drafting, linting, triage and question-answering agents across the executive, team-lead and individual-contributor layers, plus a meta layer that observes the platform and improves it.

- 
 Enforce governance in code. Risk tiers the pipeline actually enforces, least-privilege credentials per agent, tool-permission gates, a decision audit log, and autonomy classes where the dangerous class has no code path rather than a warning label. Nothing runs without a registered owner, tier, tool grant and human gate.

- 
 Design how the system contacts people. A hard interruption budget per person, message bundling instead of a stream of pings, and a structure that gives something useful before it asks for anything. Adoption depends on this more than on any other single design choice.

- 
 Own the platform tooling. The compiler and validator, inventory integrity, and the paths that distribute context and capabilities into the repositories and chat surfaces where work happens.

- 
 Compute the operating measures from production data. A pipeline from raw system activity through to a computed maturity grade per team, defensible enough that a team can dispute the result and be answered with the query rather than an opinion.

- 
 Instrument the platform's own return. A ledger that logs the work each agent absorbs and computes the monthly figure, so the value of the system is a measurement rather than a claim.

 How You'll Think

 Recursive Thinking

 You build the generator, not the artifact. When you need thirty agents, you do not write thirty agents; you build the inventory, the compiler and the distribution path that makes the thirty-first cost an afternoon, then a meta layer whose job is to watch the platform, find its drift and file the fix.

 The evaluation layer is the same move applied to trust. You are not checking whether one agent is correct today. You are building the machine that decides whether every future agent is allowed to ship, which

 ESOP

 Flexible Work

 Professional Development

 ~400 team members

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

 Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake. 

 Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

 As a Senior Renewal Manager, Enterprise at Chainguard, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the retention and long-term success of our largest and most strategic customers.
