 How we work

- 
 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- 
 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- 
 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- 
 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- 
 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 What we offer

- 
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- 
 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- 
 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- 
 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- 
 Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

- 
 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

 About the role 

 ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

 You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

 You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

 Requirements 

- 
 Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

- 
 Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

- 
 Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

- 
 Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

- 
 Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

 Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

 Location 

 This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

 #LI-Remote

About the Role 

 Vantage is looking for its next Full Stack Engineer to join our Product Development Team. As a Full Stack Engineer, you’ll work across the stack to build and maintain performant, scalable systems that power a key area of our platform. You’ll collaborate closely with other like minded engineers and product managers to deliver features that are technically robust and deeply user-focused. We’re looking for someone who shares our passion and is motivated by the impact great software can have on the user journey.

 This posting is for a new position (newly created role).

 Minimum Requirements 

- 
 3+ years of experience working across both the back and front end of SaaS (Software as a Service) products.

- 
 Experience with Javascript and its common frameworks such as React.

- 
 Experience designing and executing both unit and integration tests, with tools such as pytest, jest, react testing framework, etc.

- 
 Experience working with large data sets.

- 
 Experience monitoring application performance, debugging, and reviewing logs.

- 
 Familiarity working with Continuous Integrations and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD).

- 
 Familiarity working with cloud platforms such as Azure, GCP, and/or AWS.

- 
 Track record of successful collaboration with other engineering and product teams.

 Preferred Experience 

- 
 BA in Computer Science, or Computer Engineering or similarly relevant degree and/or experience in the AdTech industry.

- 
 Proficiency with Python and Django (DRF and classic).

- 
 Proficiency with Typescript, React and Redux.

 Role Responsibilities 

- 
 Write maintainable, performant code to build reliable features that drive product value and user satisfaction.

- 
 Maintain strong test coverage to uphold high code quality and ensure a stable, trustworthy product experience.

- 
 Contribute to architectural discussions and feature solutioning to ensure scalable and effective product design decisions.

- 
 Document new and existing features clearly and effectively to support team alignment and aid in future development.

- 
 Collaborate closely with engineering, UX, and product teams to deliver cohesive, user-focused solutions that meet business goals.

- 
 Owning features from technical design through production deployment and post-release support.

- 
 Taking responsibility for the reliability and correctness of the code you ship.

 About Vantage 
Vantage is the first unified platform purpose-built for retail media orchestration, empowering enterprise retailers to seamlessly activate onsite, offsite, and in-store advertising. With a global presence in North America and Asia-Pacific, Vantage enables retailers to launch and grow their media networks through scalable technology and automated workflows, and is trusted by leading retailers like The Home Depot to power their retail media programs.

 For a closer look at what we do, our culture, and our benefits, check out our about us and careers pages.

 Remote-First, Based in Toronto 
Vantage is proudly headquartered in Toronto, but we’re a remote-first team spread across North America (and beyond). Our flexible work philosophy means team members can thrive from wherever they do their best work—whether that’s from a home office, a local café, or while adding stamps to their passport. With a remote-friendly setup, home office support, and annual company retreats, we stay connected, collaborative, and energized—no matter the time zone.

 Vantage’s Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion 

 Vantage Analytics is fueled by the diversity of our talented employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and embrace ALL individuals and what makes them unique. We believe our employees should be happy and healthy, with peace of mind and a sense of fulfillment. We encourage all individuals to apply for positions that fit their passions.

 We promote equality and strive to provide all current and prospective employees with support and opportunities. Reasonable accommodations are available to job applicants on request and throughout the application process.

 How Vantage Uses AI in the Recruitment Process 

 At Vantage, we use AI-enabled tools to support our hiring process. This may include using AI to help organize, screen, and assess applications. We are committed to using these tools responsibly, and ensuring every candidate is treated fairly throughout the process.

 All hiring decisions at Vantage are made by our team. Who we invite to work at Vantage is a decision we only trust ourselves to make.

 What's Next? 
We thank all applicants in advance for their interest in this position, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 As part of the final stages of our hiring process, all candidates will be required to successfully complete a criminal background check.

About Sayari : 

 Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

 Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do.

 The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard.

 You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. You sit in the same org as Forward Deployed Engineers and the Product team. The field shapes the roadmap, and Product sets it.

- Customers buy answers. Superconductor reasons like an expert analyst at machine scale. The analyst’s job shifts from producing every answer by hand to directing, validating, and extending what Superconductor produces, and teaching customer analysts to do the same. 

- Context should survive the contract. The analyst who designed the proof-of-value knows why the success criteria are what they are. Keeping that analyst on the account protects delivery quality and surfaces the next problem before the customer names it.

- Tradecraft is built in the field. Field Intelligence Analysts see what was promised, what was delivered, and what the customer did with it. That full view produces better methodology, better evals, and a better Superconductor than any single-phase role can.

 What You Will Do 

 Own the analytical relationship, end to end 

- Run discovery and proof-of-value engagements anchored on work the customer already pays people to do, such as alert adjudication, due diligence, investigations, and case prioritization. Define success criteria you will personally be accountable for delivering.

- Stay on the account after close and deliver the work you scoped. This includes multi-hop investigations across ownership, trade, and corporate records, plus analytical briefings and training.

- Serve as the customer’s single analytical point of contact from first conversation through renewal.

- Pair with FDEs on discovery and delivery. You define the analytical requirement, they build it, and you validate it against the mission.

- When something built for one customer should be rebuilt for many, make the case to Product with evidence: the problem, the workaround, and the customers who share it.

- Document where the platform falls short of the mission, with raw examples attached.

- Train and certify customer analysts on Sayari methods and on working with Superconductor. Identify the customer experts who should go further.

 Build the tradecraft 

- Capture the judgment calls, non-obvious pivots, and creative approaches from live engagements. Contribute them to the Tradecraft team as expert-annotated reference cases, eval scenarios, and training material.

- Hold your work to the Field Intelligence standard, and help raise it.

 Support Go-To-Market Teams

About Supabase

 Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

 About the Role

 We're looking for a Developer Relations Engineer based in London to join our team and help more developers discover, learn, and build with Supabase. You'll create high-impact content, build real-world projects, and represent Supabase across communities and events. If you're equally energized by writing code and teaching others, this is the role for you.

 Why This Role Matters

 Supabase is growing fast with 350,000+ developers , 1,000+ OSS contributors , and a thriving open source ecosystem. Our users are builders, startup founders, weekend hackers, and engineers scaling to millions of users. DevRel is how we meet them where they are: through content, community, and code.

 We're building a community of communities that brings together developers from many backgrounds, including first-time open source contributors. As a DevRel Engineer, you'll be a bridge between Supabase and the broader developer ecosystem, helping people get started, go deep, and feel connected.

 What You'll Do

- 
 Make content — Publish compelling technical content, especially video, to help developers learn Supabase quickly

- 
 Build demos and tutorials — Ship real-world apps using Supabase and tools like Next.js, React, and Stripe. Write guides that others can follow and remix

- 
 Represent Supabase — Speak at meetups, livestream builds, and engage with the developer ecosystem. You'll be a visible and trusted voice of the platform

- 
 Support and grow the community — Celebrate contributors, answer questions, highlight cool projects, and bring developer feedback to the team

- 
 Collaborate across the company — Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users

 You Might Be a Good Fit If

- 
 You've built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge

- 
 You create content that makes people want to open their code editor

- 
 You're equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript

- 
 You're energized by community whether it's on Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or in person

- 
 You're self-directed, organized, and excited to contribute to open source

 Requirements

 This role is based in London to support regular in-person DevRel video shoots, attend local events, and be an active presence in the London tech ecosystem.

- 
 Strong engineering skills, especially with JavaScript or TypeScript, Postgres, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, etc.)

- 
 Experience creating technical content (written or video)

- 
 Comfortable representing a product publicly (on camera, on stage, or online)

 Bonus Points If You Have

- 
 A growing audience on YouTube, Twitch, or Twitter

- 
 Prior experience in DevRel or open source

- 
 Have used (and loved) Supabase

 What We Offer 

- 
 Fully Remote 

 We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- 
 ESOP 

 Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- 
 Tech Allowance 

 Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- 
 Health Benefits 

 Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- 
 Annual Off-Sites 

 Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- 
 Flexible Work 

 We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- 
 Professional Development 

 Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

 About the Team 

 Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- 
 ~400 team members

- 
 60+ countries

- 
 20+ languages spoken

- 
 Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 
 540,000+ community members

 We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

 We’re on a mission to modernize insurance, making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that has remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here to change that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re looking for a Bilingual Quebec Licensed Insurance Advisor to help us build the future of insurance in Canada and beyond.

 On a typical day, you’ll be educating our customers on their insurance needs by answering challenging questions, dealing with advanced customer cases, and guiding them through our different products. You will be on the front lines of PolicyMe: managing all inbound leads through their policy applications, and ensuring they get the coverage they need (and feel good about the process) via phone, SMS and email!

 How it is different from a typical insurance advisor role: 

 This is an opportunity to be part of a dynamic and rapidly growing startup, with opportunity for upward mobility. Be involved in discussions across the organization on how to streamline operations, improve the customer experience and build innovative insurance products. Ride a wave of industry disruption, instead of fighting against it!

- Help prospective clients navigate life, critical illness, and health & dental insurance options using PolicyMe’s digital platform and your product knowledge

- Speak with customers in both French & English to answer questions and guide them through the buying process

- Manage a high-volume pipeline of 300–350 inbound leads each month

- Use HubSpot to track conversations, follow-ups, and application stages

- Recommend the right coverage based on customer needs, using a clear and honest consultative approach

- Maintain high-quality service across phone, email, and SMS channels

- Address customer questions related to their needs, product details, or how the insurance process works

- Collaborate with teammates and team leads to help improve workflows and elevate the customer experience

- Ensure every prospective customer receives the same honest, helpful, and human service PolicyMe is known for

- Other duties as required

 Team alignment:

- This role may fall under either the Sales or Retention team, depending on hiring priorities. Sales-focused advisors will help convert inbound leads into new customers, while Retention-aligned advisors will focus on renewals and supporting existing policyholders. Both tracks offer opportunities for impact and advancement.

 What we are looking for:

- Bilingual in French and English, with strong written and verbal communication in both

- Open to obtaining licensing in Quebec if not already licensed there

- A licensed Life and Accident & Sickness insurance agent with a valid LLQP

- 1 - 4 years of experience in insurance or a related industry

- Experience managing a high-volume pipeline with strong organizational skills

- A proven track record of exceeding sales targets in a consultative sales environment

- Ability to manage objections and explain complex concepts clearly

- A natural conversationalist who builds rapport easily and makes clients feel heard

- High empathy and discretion, especially when speaking about personal or financial topics

- Coachable and a strong desire to learn and improve

- A growth mindset with the ability to adapt to change and contribute to continuous improvement

- Ownership over your work and your pipeline

- Alignment with PolicyMe’s values and commitment to putting the customer’s best interest first

- Group Insurance of Persons license is considered a great asset

 Please note: As a standard procedure for audit compliance, this position is subject to credit checks, background checks, and reference checks.

 Why join us:

- Generous PTO - 20 vacation days

- A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe

- Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential

- An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry

- Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!)

- Access to stock options based on performance

- Compensation: The total target cash compensation for this role (including OTE) is $88,000 with earnings potential up to $120,000 CAD. We’ll walk through the details together during the interview.

About Palmstreet: 

 Palmstreet is a community-obsessed live shopping platform connecting over 2 million passionate collectors and sellers. Started in 2020, we have grown into one of the largest live shopping platforms in the US, featuring 1000+ daily live streams.

 Backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, we’re building the “World’s Online Main Street”—bringing authentic personal connections and the excitement of discovering one-of-a-kind products to online commerce.

 We launched in Mexico in September 2026. Mexico is our first international market and the template for our expansion across Latin America.

 The Opportunity 

 Palmstreet is looking for a Contador Público Certificado (Senior Accountant) to be our first finance hire in Mexico. You will own everything that keeps Palmstreet compliant in Mexico: setting up our local entity, running Mexico tax compliance, and keeping the Mexican books.

 You will report to our Head of Finance and work closely with our engineering team and outside advisors. You will be the person SAT-facing questions come to. This is a hands-on role: you will both design the process and do the work.

 The position is fully remote, based anywhere in Mexico, with regular overlap with US Pacific time.

 Responsibilities 

 Entity setup and structure 

- 
 Lead incorporation of our Mexican subsidiary with outside counsel: entity type, notarial deed, Public Registry of Commerce, RFC, e.firma, Certificado de Sello Digital, tax domicile and Buzón Tributario.

- 
 Advise on the operating model between our US parent and the Mexican entity, including intercompany agreements and transfer pricing documentation.

- 
 Register with IMSS, INFONAVIT and state payroll tax as we hire locally; set up bank accounts and payment flows with our payments partners.

- 
 Manage the transition from the US entity’s current Mexico registrations to the local entity.

 Marketplace tax compliance 

- 
 Own Palmstreet’s obligations as a digital platform that intermediates sales between third parties: ISR and IVA withholding on seller sales, monthly SAT information returns, and withholding receipts to sellers.

- 
 Own IVA on our platform and seller fees, including the foreign digital services rules for as long as the US entity bills Mexican users.

- 
 Define how we collect and validate seller tax data (RFC, tax regime, constancia de situación fiscal) and the withholding rates that apply when a seller has none.

- 
 File monthly provisional ISR and IVA payments, DIOT and the annual corporate return; manage the Buzón Tributario and any SAT requests, audits or clarifications.

- 
 Track tax reform each year (Paquete Económico, Miscelánea Fiscal) and turn changes into product and process requirements.

 CFDI and e-invoicing 

- 
 Be the business owner of our CFDI integration with a provider such as Facturapi: invoice types, uses, payment methods, global invoices to público en general, payment complements, credit notes, cancellations and withholding CFDIs.

- 
 Write CFDI requirements with engineering, test edge cases (refunds, partial shipments, cancelled orders, sellers without RFC) and reconcile issued CFDIs to transactions every month.

- 
 Monitor SAT catalog and CFDI version changes and keep us current.

 Accounting and reporting 

- 
 Keep the Mexican entity’s books under Mexican GAAP (NIF) and SAT electronic accounting (chart of accounts and monthly trial balance submissions).

- 
 Run the monthly close for Mexico: bank, payment processor, seller payout and withholding reconciliations.

- 
 Prepare US GAAP reporting packages for consolidation and support our US audit and board reporting.

- 
 Manage local payroll compliance (ISR withholding, IMSS, PTU profit sharing) as the team grows.

- 
 Build the Mexico compliance calendar and make sure nothing is filed late.

 Seller Payments, Accounts Payable and Other Duties 

- 
 Oversee seller payment flows, transitioning them from manual to automated payouts

- 
 Own the AP processes for the business in Mexico, ensuring timely and accurate payments to vendors

- 
 Perform other duties as assigned to build processes to enable the scaling of the business in Mexico, working cross functionally as needed

 Qualifications 

- 
 Based in Mexico with authorization to work locally.

- 
 Licenciatura en Contaduría Pública with cédula profesional; IMCP certification (Contador Público Certificado) strongly preferred.

- 
 7+ years in Mexican tax and accounting, including time at a Big 4 or mid-size firm and at least 2 years in-house.

 Hands-on experience with CFDI 4.0 at high volume and with electronic accounting submissions.

- 
 Working knowledge of the digital platform regime (withholding on platform sellers), IVA on digital services and transfer pricing.

- 
 Experience setting up a Mexican subsidiary for a foreign parent.

- 
 Professional working proficiency in English; you will write memos and present to a US-based Head of Finance weekly.

- 
 Comfortable in spre

 AlertMedia is looking for an HR Operations & Payroll Specialist to join our growing People team in Mexico. This role will help build and manage the operational foundation of our Mexico People function, supporting payroll, benefits, HR systems, time and attendance, statutory compliance, employee lifecycle administration, and vendor coordination. 

 Reporting to the Regional HR Manager and partnering closely with Global HR Operations, Finance, Revenue Operations, Legal, and external providers, you will help ensure our People Operations processes are accurate, compliant, scalable, and deliver a great employee experience. 

 Who you are: 

 You are a detail-oriented and service-minded HR Operations professional who enjoys bringing structure to complex processes. You understand that great People Operations requires both accuracy and strong employee experience. You are comfortable working across payroll, benefits, systems, and vendors, and you know how to spot discrepancies, ask the right questions, follow through, and escalate when needed. 

 You thrive in a growing environment where not every process is fully built yet, and you are excited by the opportunity to help create, document, and improve the way we operate. 

 What you get to do every day: 

- Own the end-to-end payroll cycle including collecting, validating, and reporting payroll-impacting incidents, preparing pre-payroll inputs for review and approval, reviewing outputs and reconciling employee data, coordinating corrections with our payroll provider, and provide employee payroll and pay slip support.

- Coordinate recurring Mexico payroll and social security requirements, including IMSS, INFONAVIT, FONACOT, SUA/SIPARE, PTU, aguinaldo, vacation premium, and related obligations.

- Administer Mexico HRIS and employee records, including PTO, absences, schedules, time and attendance, and employee changes, and maintain complete, accurate, audit-ready documentation (including IMSS affiliation/AFIL records) to support recurring compliance and audit activities.

- Manage day-to-day benefits administration, including Major Medical Insurance and meal vouchers, from enrollment and employee changes through ongoing vendor administration and new-hire onboarding.

- Serve as the primary operational contact for Mexico HR vendors, including payroll, benefits, and meal voucher providers, tracking deliverables, deadlines, open items, and routine issue resolution.

- Serve as a first-line HR Operations resource for Mexico employees and help document, simplify, and continuously improve People processes as the team grows.

- Contribute to AlertMedia's culture and values by supporting the Regional HR Manager with the coordination and execution of Mexico employee experience initiatives, including Tuesday Lunch, team events, and other special activities.

 What you bring to the role: 

- 3+ years of relevant experience in HR Operations, payroll administration, People Operations, or a related HR role in Mexico.

- Hands-on experience supporting Mexican payroll and pre-payroll processes, ideally in partnership with an external payroll provider.

- Working knowledge of Mexican payroll and social security requirements, including IMSS, INFONAVIT, FONACOT, SUA/SIPARE, PTU, aguinaldo, vacation premium, and related statutory obligations.

- Experience administering HRIS, payroll, time and attendance, and/or benefits systems; Rippling experience is a plus.

- Experience coordinating employee benefits and relationships with payroll, benefits, or other HR vendors is strongly preferred.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, exceptional attention to detail, and a high degree of organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage recurring deadlines, identify discrepancies across systems and data, and effectively leverage AI tools to improve accuracy, efficiency, and processes.

- A service-oriented approach to employee support and the discretion to handle confidential employee and payroll information appropriately.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Spanish and English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with teams and stakeholders across Mexico and the United States.

- Accounting experience is a plus.

 Location: This is a hybrid position (3 days a week) in our downtown Mexico City (Reforma area)

vacantes.descripcion:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

 This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater 

 In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

 Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

 You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

 You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 Key Responsibilities 

- Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.

- Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.

- Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.

- Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.

- Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.

- Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.

- Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 If hired we will ask you to submit a copy of your Independent Contractor Registration and/or Certificate of Vigilance. This documentation may be obtained from the URSSAF (Union de Recouvrement des Cotisations de Sécurité Sociale et d'Allocations Familiales) and also through https://www.guichet-entreprises.fr/.

 TELUS Digital AI Community 

 Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

 Qualification path

 Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 Basic Requirements 

- Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in French & English. 

- Resident in France for the last 5 consecutive years. 

- Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.

- Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.

- Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.

- Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.

- Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification

- Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.

- High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.

- Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.

- Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.

- Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 Equal Opportunity 

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

 At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

About ElevenLabs

 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

 We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- 
 ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- 
 ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- 
 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

 How we work

- 
 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- 
 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- 
 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- 
 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- 
 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 What we offer

- 
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- 
 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- 
 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- 
 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- 
 Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- 
 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

 About the Role 

 As the Account Management Lead you'll lead a team of experienced account managers across the UK&I region. You'll balance people leadership, strategic direction, and hands-on customer impact - driving excellence in post-sales outcomes and ensuring your team consistently delivers measurable value to customers and the business.

 You will: 

- 
 Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing AM team, owning team and regional NRR performance, customer retention, and expansion goals.

- 
 Act as a player-coach: directly manage priority accounts, join key customer conversations, and model best-in-class success practices.

- 
 Lead by example in complex post-sales and renewal cycles, unblocking issues, driving adoption, and identifying expansion opportunities.

- 
 Set strategic direction for the team, aligning customer success initiatives with company goals and market trends.

- 
 Monitor and optimize delivery quality across all accounts, ensuring consistency, excellence, and predictability in customer outcomes, implementing scalable processes that improve accuracy, visibility, and operational efficiency.

- 
 Design and implement repeatable playbooks for renewals, upsells, and adoption; automate workflows and tools to scale team impact.

- 
 Own the ongoing development and optimization of best practices for Commercial and Scale playbooks, ensuring consistent execution, measurable impact, and continuous refinement as the business evolves.

- 
 Build and maintain executive-level relationships across priority accounts, serving as a strategic advisor and customer advocate in internal and external forums.

- 
 Represent the voice of the customer in leadership discussions, influencing roadmap, operations, and revenue strategies.

- 
 Partner with Europe GTM & cross functional leadership to align organizational objectives, drive cross-functional initiatives, and ensure cohesive execution across customer success, sales, and operations teams.

 Requirements 

 • 10+ years of experience in Account Management or post-sales roles within SaaS, ideally some of this within UK&I accounts.

 • Demonstrated technical acumen with the ability to upskill and enable the team — fostering confidence in navigating product capabilities, integrations, and data insights to strengthen customer outcomes.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Legal Drafting & Document Preparation 

- Draft, prepare, and revise estate planning documents, trust agreements, probate petitions, and related legal forms using established templates and attorney instructions.

- Customize existing legal templates and prior case documents for new matters, ensuring all client information and case-specific details are accurately updated.

- Assist with preparing property deeds and related documentation for real estate transfers in Hawaii.

- Review and incorporate legal property descriptions, including Exhibit A attachments, into trust documents and deeds.

- Prepare court documents and filing materials in accordance with applicable Hawaii probate procedures and attorney guidance.

- Assist with trust administration documentation, including signature records and notarization-related paperwork.

- Organize and maintain electronic client files, legal documents, and case records.

 Required Qualifications

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Word, and other standard legal administrative tools.

- Professionalism, reliability, and commitment to maintaining strict client confidentiality.

 Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with Hawaii probate procedures and legal documentation.

- Experience preparing property deeds or handling real estate transfer documentation.

- Understanding of Hawaii's Land Court and Regular System recording requirements.

- Experience with international or cross-border estate planning matters.

- Familiarity with Japanese language or culture is a plus but not required.

- Experience supporting solo practitioners or small U.S. law firms.

 Work Schedule & Arrangement 

- Location: Fully Remote – Latin America.

- Employment Type: Part-Time.

- Initial Workload: Approximately 4–5 hours per week, depending on the firm's needs.

- Growth Potential: Opportunity to increase working hours as the firm's workload expands.

- Enjoys detailed, accuracy-focused work.

- Can efficiently adapt existing templates to new client matters.

- Is comfortable handling both paralegal and administrative responsibilities.

- Demonstrates initiative, accountability, and the ability to work with minimal supervision.

 Build backend services, APIs and workflows for the AI Neobank app.

 Improve system reliability, observability, security and performance.

 Build systems that are practical, auditable and ready for regulated financial products.

 What We're Looking For

 3+ years of backend engineering experience.

 Strong fundamentals in APIs, databases, system design and production debugging.

 Experience building scalable services and integrating third-party systems.

 Good understanding of security, reliability, data quality and operational edge cases.

 Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, quality and risk.

 Comfortable working with product, mobile, operations and business teams.

 Experience in fintech, payments, insurance, lending, banking or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 Builds systems that work in the real world, not just on diagrams.

 Thinks through edge cases, failure modes and operational impact.

- 
 Can move fast without creating fragile foundations.

 Takes ownership of production issues and long-term reliability.

 This Role Is Not For

 Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

 What Youâll Bring

We are seeking experienced engineers, managers, and contract consultants for full-time or part-time positions to support US and international projects. Virtual offices considered. About ElevenLabs 

 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

 We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- 
 ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- 
 ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- 
 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- 
 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 What we offer

- 
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- 
 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- 
 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- 
 Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

- 
 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

- 
 Organise third-party conferences, owned branded events, and strategic dinners with key customers and prospects across Brazil and LATAM

- 
 Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and GTM teams for seamless execution

 Create compelling event messaging that resonates with Brazilian and LATAM business audiences

 Build and maintain relationships with sponsors, partners, and vendors across Brazil and LATAM

 What you bring:

 5+ years events experience, with at least three in tech event marketing

 Native Portuguese speaker, English fluency required (Spanish a plus)

- 
 Deep knowledge of the Brazilian and LATAM tech ecosystems and key industry events, including events in São Paulo and beyond

 Experience working with Brazilian and LATAM event agencies and production partners

 This role is remote within Brazil. Preferred to be based in São Paulo.

 About the Role
 We're looking for a E-commerce Operations Manager to take ownership of day-to-day website operations across the UK and US markets.
 You'll manage promotions, product launches, storefront updates, quality assurance, and third-party Shopify apps to deliver a reliable, seamless customer experience.
 This role goes beyond website maintenance. You'll use Claude, Shopify Sidekick, and Shopify Flow to automate repetitive processes, reduce manual work, and create scalable operating routines.
 As your automation efforts free up capacity, you'll collaborate with the Growth team on conversion optimization, A/B testing, and customer journey improvements.
 You'll report to the Head of Growth and collaborate closely with the Lead Developer, Growth Manager, CRM & Retention, Creative, and Customer Service teams.
 Responsibilities

- Own the monthly Shopify promotion cycle across UK and US markets, ensuring accurate pricing, discounts, scheduling, and promotional changes.

- Deliver seamless product launches by managing SKUs, variants, imagery, descriptions, collections, preorders, and product drops.

- Build and maintain campaign landing pages using existing Shopify components and AI-powered page-building tools.

- Protect the customer experience through thorough QA testing across product pages, navigation, subscriptions, carts, and checkout on desktop and mobile.

- Manage Shopify storefront applications, including Skio, AfterSell, and Fairing, while tracking application ownership, costs, and renewals.

- Automate promotions, product setup, and pre-launch QA workflows using Claude, Shopify Flow, Shopify Sidekick, and scheduled checks.

- Create proactive monitoring routines to identify pricing inconsistencies, product availability issues, and other storefront errors before they affect customers.

- Document operational processes and develop reusable workflows that reduce manual workload and improve team efficiency.

- Support A/B testing initiatives by launching experiments, monitoring results, and documenting findings alongside the Growth team.

- Analyze customer behavior using GA4, Microsoft Clarity, and Fairing to identify friction points and recommend conversion improvements.

- At least 3 years of hands-on Shopify administration experience within a direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce brand. 

- Experience managing Shopify products, pricing, discounts, Markets, promotions, and storefront applications across multiple markets or currencies. 

- Strong understanding of Shopify's ecosystem, including themes, apps, checkout processes, and subscription functionality. Coding experience is not required. 

- Practical experience using AI tools to automate daily workflows, including at least one automation or routine you have personally built and can demonstrate. 

- Strong quality assurance skills, with a structured approach to testing, identifying edge cases, documenting issues, and preventing recurring errors. 

- Working knowledge of Klaviyo and Gorgias, plus excellent written and spoken English for communicating with UK and US teams and customers. 

- Availability to work Monday to Friday, 9 AM–5 PM UK time, with some flexibility around start and finish times. 

 Nice to Have: 

- Experience supporting A/B testing and conversion rate optimization initiatives. 

- Familiarity with Skio or other subscription platforms, AfterSell, and Fairing. 

- Experience building automated workflows using Shopify Flow, n8n, Zapier, or Claude skills and connectors. 

- Familiarity with Claude Code or Cursor for small website or landing page adjustments. 

- Experience interpreting customer behavior data using GA4, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics tools.

Ververica is the original creator of Apache Flink® and remains a core contributor to it. Flink is the leading open-source engine for stream and batch processing. It runs mission-critical workloads at Netflix, Alibaba, Amazon and Uber, as well as at banks, telcos and global enterprises.

We build Ververica Unified Streaming Data Platform, an enterprise-grade platform for real-time data on top of Flink. Backed by one of the world's largest tech companies, we combine open-source innovation with long-term stability.

 WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS 
Our customers run real-time pipelines that cannot stop: fraud detection, payments, telemetry, recommendations. When something breaks, you are the engineer who gets it running again.

As a Technical Support Engineer , you will solve real production problems on Kubernetes, in the cloud and inside Flink itself. You will work side by side with the engineers who build Flink, so every hard ticket is a chance to learn how a distributed system works under the hood.

This role suits someone who enjoys a good puzzle, likes helping people and wants to grow into a stream processing expert. WHAT YOU BRING

- 2+ years in technical support or a similar hands-on role, ideally with cloud-based products.

- Solid knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).

- Practical experience with containers and Kubernetes. Our product runs on Kubernetes, so this matters.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. You enjoy finding out why something fails.

- Clear written and spoken English, and the patience to explain technical ideas to any audience.

- A customer-first mindset and the ability to stay calm when a customer is under pressure.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team.

- Curiosity and a drive to keep learning.

- A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 NICE TO HAVE 

No one ticks every box. If you have some of these, tell us. 

- Experience with stream processing, Apache Flink or Apache Kafka.

- Scripting or programming skills in Shell, Python, Java or SQL.

- Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools.

- Experience with cloud monitoring and observability tools.

- Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Azure Administrator.

 LOCATION AND WORKING HOURS 

This is a remote role for someone based between UTC-4 and UTC-7. That covers US and Canadian Eastern, Central, Mountain and Pacific time, plus Latin American countries in the same range.

- Your core hours follow customers' business day in the Americas.

- You will work closely with our EMEA support team to give customers follow-the-sun coverage.

 WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Be the first technical point of contact for customers using Ververica Unified Streaming Data Platform.

- Diagnose and fix issues across the stack, from Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure to Flink jobs, connectors and SQL.

- Reproduce tricky problems, dig through logs and metrics, and find the root cause.

- Escalate to Engineering and Product with clear, well-documented cases, and help shape fixes and product improvements.

- Explain solutions and best practices clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders alike.

- Keep accurate records of cases and resolutions in our ticketing system.

- Turn what you learn into knowledge base articles, tutorials and runbooks that help customers and teammates.

- Keep sharpening your skills in cloud technologies and stream processing, and share them with the team.

 WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive compensation: salary, equity and performance bonus

- Remote-first culture with flexible hours

- Direct access to Flink core developers and a global open-source community

- A clear path to grow into senior support, Technical Account Manager or engineering roles

- Generous vacation, personal leave and wellness benefits

At Ververica, we believe innovation starts with diverse perspectives. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you are passionate about helping customers succeed with real-time data, we would love to hear from you.

 Apache Flink® is a trademark of the Apache Software Foundation. Originally posted on Himalayas

Disclaimer: Stay safe from recruitment scams 
We only hire through , using TestGorilla assessments, video interviews and reference checks. We may contact you first on LinkedIn, but after that we only email from Teamtailor (@ / ) or @ addresses.
We will never ask you for money, interview you on Telegram or WhatsApp, or ask you to install software, connect a wallet or run code.
Not sure if a message is really from us? Ask us through our LinkedIn page before you reply.
 You know Bitrefill , and you’ve probably watched a search result or an app listing turn into revenue. You get that search no longer means just Google: people ask Claude and ChatGPT, and agents shop on their behalf. You want to own how 1M+ customers across 180+ countries find us. If that’s you, hit the apply button and let’s talk.

If you need more info to decide, keep reading. We kept the corporate fluff out, so it won't take long.

 About the role Organic discovery is changing fast. Programmatic SEO still matters, and so do the app stores. Now there’s a third channel: AI answer engines and AI agents that research, compare, and buy without ever opening a browser tab. We want Bitrefill to be the default answer in all three.
 You’ll have real freedom here. You choose where to build pages at scale, which experiments to run, and how to make us readable for machines. You’ll work closely with product, design, and engineering to get it shipped.
 What you'll do

- Own Bitrefill ’s organic growth strategy across search, app stores and AI

- Build and scale programmatic SEO: find the page types worth generating, then ship, measure and iterate

- Optimize our iOS and Android app listings with product and design: keywords, screenshots, store tests

- Make Bitrefill show up in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and whatever comes next)

- Make Bitrefill easy for AI agents to find and buy from: structured product data, machine-readable pages, and our agentic commerce work

- Write and shape content, and get your hands dirty in the front end when it’s faster than waiting on a ticket

- Track what’s working, kill what isn’t, and share findings with the team

 What we're looking for

- Be based in a timezone that aligns with Europe or the Americas

- 5+ years in growth, SEO, or performance marketing, with a track record of moving organic numbers

- Deep, hands-on programmatic and technical SEO experience. You’ve built pages at scale, not just audited them

- You’ve done hands-on GEO / AI visibility work and can show what it changed;

- AI is part of how you work (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar). This is non-negotiable for us

- Comfortable with front-end basics. Some React is great, and vibecoding the rest is fine

- Strong writer with a good eye for design

- Data-driven. You read Search Console and analytics like a P&L

- Self-driven. You spot the opportunity and push it forward instead of waiting for a roadmap

 Bonus points

- Real ASO experience on iOS and Android

- Experience with structured data, llms.txt, or agent-facing APIs and MCP

- Crypto-native. You use it, and nobody needs to explain Bitcoin to you

- Experience in e-commerce or marketplace SEO with large catalogs

- Design chops in Figma for store assets and landing pages

 Why Bitrefill 

 We've been quietly right about something since 2014: internet money should just work. Fully remote since day one. Team across 30+ countries. Get paid in crypto if you want. No bullshit meetings. Twice a year, we meet up to build together in person. The rest of the time: work hard, get shit done.

Bilingual Dispatcher (Russian–English)
 Position Overview The Bilingual Dispatcher will coordinate and manage transportation schedules, ensuring efficient communication between drivers, clients, and operations staff. This role requires fluency in both Russian and English to handle dispatching tasks, resolve issues, and maintain smooth logistics operations across diverse teams.
 Key Responsibilities

- Dispatch drivers and vehicles according to schedules, routes, and client requirements.

- Communicate effectively with Russian‑ and English‑speaking drivers, clients, and team members.

- Monitor deliveries, pickups, and route progress to ensure timely service.

- Handle incoming calls, messages, and service requests in both languages.

- Record and update dispatch logs, schedules, and reports accurately.

- Resolve scheduling conflicts, delays, and emergencies promptly.

- Collaborate with operations and customer service teams to maintain service quality.

- Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and transportation regulations.

 Qualifications
 Education & Experience

- High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor's degree in logistics, business, or related field preferred.

- Minimum 1–2 years of experience in dispatching, logistics, or transportation coordination.

 Skills & Competencies

- Fluency in both Russian and English (spoken and written).

- Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

- Proficiency with dispatching software, GPS systems, and MS Office tools.

- Ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure.

- Strong problem‑solving and conflict‑resolution skills.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★ 

 Accountant 

 Location: Remote - Colombia
 Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
 Employment Type: Independent Contractor (ongoing)
 Industry: Accounting & Advisory
 Compensation: Competitive
 Schedule: To be confirmed
 Start Date: December 14, 2026
 Experience: 1-3 years in full-cycle accounting
 English Proficiency: Professional proficiency in English required

 About the Company 

Our client is a U.S.-based accounting and advisory firm that supports established small and midsize businesses. It provides bookkeeping and foundational accounting, business-plan development, and fractional CFO support so owners have clear visibility into performance and can make better-informed decisions.

The firm works with clients across construction, skilled trades, professional services, insurance, property management, and other service-based businesses. Services are available in English and Spanish. The team focuses on accurate records, a consistent month-end process, and reports that are easy to understand, including for collaboration with each client's CPA.

The culture is built on integrity, clarity, partnership, growth, and results. The firm values practical insight, long-term relationships, and turning financial data into guidance that clients can use.

 About the Role 

A U.S.-based accounting and advisory firm is seeking an Accountant to manage full-cycle accounting for small business clients across a range of service industries.

This engagement covers general ledger work, accounts payable and receivable, journal entries, reconciliations, month-end and year-end close, and the preparation of financial statements and supporting schedules. You will maintain accurate records in QuickBooks Online and Microsoft Excel, coordinate client documentation and reporting deadlines, and follow established accounting procedures with strict confidentiality.

This remote contractor role is a strong fit for a detail-oriented accounting professional who is comfortable supporting U.S.-based small businesses and working with clear processes. There is potential to transition into a full-time position, based on performance and business needs.

 Why This Opportunity? 

- Full-cycle accounting ownership for U.S.-based small business clients, not a narrow single-task bookkeeping brief.

- Hands-on work across the general ledger, AP, AR, reconciliations, close, and financial statements.

- Experience with QuickBooks Online and Microsoft Excel in a firm that also offers advisory and fractional CFO support.

- Fully remote role open to professionals in Latin America, Southeast Asia, and India.

- Ongoing contractor engagement, with potential to transition into a full-time position based on performance and business needs.

- A culture that values integrity, clarity, partnership, growth, and results.

 What You'll Do 
 Full-Cycle Accounting 

- Manage general ledger accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and journal entries.

- Perform bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations.

- Complete month-end and year-end closing procedures.

 Reporting, Records & Client Coordination 

- Prepare financial statements and supporting schedules.

- Maintain accurate records using QuickBooks Online and Microsoft Excel.

- Coordinate client documentation, reporting deadlines, and administrative tasks.

- Follow established accounting procedures and maintain strict confidentiality.

 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications 

- 1-3 years of relevant experience in full-cycle accounting.

- Education in accounting, finance, or a related field.

- Proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Microsoft Excel.

- Knowledge of U.S. GAAP.

- Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills.

- Professional proficiency in English.

- Able to work fully remotely from Latin America, Southeast Asia, or India.

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience supporting U.S.-based small businesses.

- Bilingual English and Spanish.

 Tools You Will Use 
QuickBooks Online and Microsoft Excel.

 How Success Is Measured 

- General ledger, AP, AR, and journal entries are managed accurately and on time.

- Bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations are completed thoroughly.

- Month-end and year-end close procedures are completed to standard.

- Financial statements and supporting schedules are prepared accurately and on deadline.

- Records in QuickBooks Online and Microsoft Excel stay accurate and well organized.

- Client documentation, reporting deadlines, and administrative tasks are coordinated reliably.

- Established procedures are followed, and client information is kept strictly confidential.

 Why Join Us 

- Fully remote opportunity from Latin America, Southeast Asia, or India.

- Competitive compensation.

- An ongoing independent contractor role with potential to transition into a full-time position, based on performance and business needs.

- Full-cycle accounting work

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented CEO Office Associate with strong operational drive who wants to play a vital role in enabling our mission on climate solutions.

This role serves as the logistical and administrative backbone of the CEO Office, focusing on complex end-to-end international travel, administrative operations, expense management, and executive hospitality. Working across multiple time zones, the CEO Office Associate will also play a key role in building and polishing executive presentations, slide decks, and meeting collateral, while providing seamless calendar backup when needed.

The CEO and Chief of Staff operate in a fast-paced global environment. This position requires meticulous precision, sound operational judgement, high discretion, and the confidence to take ownership of tasks to keep our leadership team running smoothly. Reporting to the CEO Office Operations Manager, this role requires close collaboration with colleagues and stakeholder EAs across geographies, strong communication skills, and the ability to adapt quickly to shifting priorities. 

 If you excel at creating structure amid constant change, enjoy problem-solving, and take satisfaction in making complex logistics run smoothly, while helping drive meaningful change, we’d love for you to apply. 
 How you'll contribute

 Inbox Operations & Diary Continuity (Support & Back-up) 

- 
 Administrative Inbox Triaging: Monitor the CEO Office inbox for administrative confirmations, receipts, vendor communications, and routine inquiries

- 
 Participate in a weekly diary review and look-ahead session to anticipate upcoming needs and manage last-minute changes

- 
 Business Continuity & Absence Coverage : Provide complete diary coverage in the absence of the Senior Executive Assistant and during peak workload periods managing real-time schedule shifts and urgent calendar requests under the guidance of the CEO Office Operations Manager

 Travel and Logistics for CEO & Chief Of Staff 

- End-to-End Travel Booking: Execute comprehensive international travel bookings (flights, rail, hotels, ground transport)

- Track travel plans across the year to identify opportunities for stakeholder meetings or events while the CEO and or the Chief of Staff are in-country

- Administrative Travel Requirements: Fully own visa applications, passport renewals, travel insurance, vaccination requirements, and destination logistics

- Ensure the knowledge-management of all of the above is sound so the Operations manager, the Chief of Staff and the CEO know where to find what they need while travelling

 Meeting Logistics, Materials & Executive Hospitality 

- 
 Presentations, Decks & Materials Support: Format and polish presentations, handouts, and meeting collateral for executive reviews, team updates, and leadership meetings

- 
 Meeting Setup & Hospitality: Book internal & external meeting rooms, arrange catering, coordinate AV/tech setup

- 
 Meeting Pack Distribution: Ensure all completed briefing materials, agendas, and presentation collateral are formatted, circulated, and ready in advance

 Administration, Coordination and Ad Hoc Support 

- Manage expenses for the CEO and Chief of Staff, including collating, verifying, and uploading receipts to the expense system

- Support invoice processing, budget tracking, and accurate record-keeping

- Maintain and support the optimization of the CEO Office Google Drive file management system, ensuring structured organization, naming conventions, and secure access control

- Work closely with the CEO Office Operations Manager and Senior Executive Assistant to ensure alignment and consistency across the CEO Office

- Provide administrative and logistical support for internal projects and events

- Undertake other reasonable duties as requested by the CEO Office Operations Manager

 Our ideal candidate has

- Relevant work experience as an Executive Assistant or experience in a similar position working for a busy principal, with a proven track record of autonomously managing a complicated schedule, with upward management skills developed in a fast-paced, global, impact-driven environment.

- Proven ability to manage complex schedules autonomously, exercise sound judgement, and influence upwards with confidence and tact.

- Strong planning, coordination, and prioritisation skills, with the ability to stay composed and effective amid constant change.

- A proactive, solution-focused mindset with meticulous attention to detail and excellent follow-through.

- Flexibility to handle last-minute requests and shifting priorities.

- Excellent communication skills with a good level of English (written and spoken), other languages an asset.

- High level of discretion, professionalism, and reliability when handling sensitive information.

- The ability to process a high volume of information, and connect dots across different workstreams.

 Location: Remote

- Heart failure management

- Cardiology

- Advanced cardiovascular therapies

- Clinical reasoning

- Evidence-based medicine

- Mechanical circulatory support

- Transplant cardiology

- Medical content evaluation

- Medical annotation

- Ai model evaluation

- English (b2 or above)

- Attention to detail

- Analytical skills

 This opportunity involves applying specialized clinical knowledge to assess AI-generated medical information related to heart failure, complex cardiovascular conditions, and advanced treatment strategies.
 Key Responsibilities:

- Evaluate AI-generated clinical content related to heart failure diagnosis and management.

- Review medical scenarios involving advanced heart failure, cardiomyopathies, and complex cardiovascular care.

- Assess the accuracy of clinical reasoning involving mechanical circulatory support, transplantation, and advanced therapies.

- Provide evidence-based feedback to improve AI-generated medical recommendations.

 Requirements:

- MD, DO, or internationally equivalent medical degree.

- Board certification in cardiology or equivalent specialist qualification.

- Active or recent clinical practice in heart failure or advanced cardiovascular medicine.

- Strong knowledge of heart failure management, cardiomyopathies, and advanced cardiovascular therapies.

- English proficiency at B2 level or above.

 Preferred Qualifications:

- Specialized training in advanced heart failure or transplant cardiology.

- Experience with ventricular assist devices, transplant evaluation, or mechanical circulatory support.

- Previous experience in AI model evaluation, medical annotation, or RLHF.

 Selection Process:

- Application

- AI Interview

- Domain-Specific Screening

- Onboarding Call

- Prior AI experience is not required.

Position Overview:

- Responsible for collecting all medical records, medical bills, and supporting documentation to prepare a demand package to be sent to an insurance company.

- Requires consistent follow-up over the phone and email to ensure all requests are processed in a timely manner.

- Ensure the clients receive excellent customer service and guide them through the process while the case remains in your stage.

 Job Description & Responsibilities – including but not limited to: 

- Request medical records and bills via email, fax, and/or mail.

- Contact medical providers and adjusters through email and over the phone to follow-up on requests.

- Pay for any invoices received in order to obtain medical records and bills requested and document the expense in our case management system.

- Review all medical records and bills to ensure accuracy and request amendments/corrections when needed.

- Update our case management software by uploading all documents received, linking emails, and updating all links related to the demand process.

- Prepare demand packages with all medical records and bills in chronological order by provider.

- Submit demand packages for review and apply corrections as needed.

- Write additional demands and submit them for case manager and attorney review.

- Send demands via email, fax, and or mail.

- Maintain consistent client communication through intro calls and courtesy calls to keep the client updated throughout the demand stage.

 Working schedule: Monday - Friday 8:30AM to 5:00PM

- Must be fluent in English and Spanish.

- Must consistently be on time and reliable.

- Must work well in a team environment.

- Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to successfully communicate with other employees.

- Must have proficiency in using computers and relevant software.

- Must be able to prioritize tasks effectively.

- Must possess strong multitasking and time-management skills.

*Resume MUST be in English

 Location: LATAM

 Role: Account Executive (Spanish Speaker)

 Department: Sales Department

 About Respond.io 

 Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.

 Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.

 We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!

 Our Culture 

 At , we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

- 
 Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!

- 
 The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.

- 
 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.

- 
 Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!

- 
 Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.

- 
 Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!

 Role Description 

 At Respond.io , Sales are pivotal to our company’s success. As a sales personnel, you will be using proactive and inbound selling strategies to engage with mid to large-size businesses to close new business. You will use your knowledge of handling B2B sales to identify business opportunities with current leads and prospective key clients.

 We are looking for a Account Executive to join our Sales team and focus on our Mid Market customers across LATAM. This segment represents a huge opportunity for and we want someone who is eager to do the best work of their lives while supporting others in doing the same.

 You will be responsible for driving the sales process with prospective customers as well as expansion within existing accounts. You will work closely with our customers to understand their business goals and act as their trusted guide to understanding how would be a good fit in their organization. You'll also work with cross-functional teams to help align our product roadmap and marketing materials with customer feedback. If you enjoy working with customers from a variety of industries in a rapidly changing environment, then come and join us!

 Responsibilities 

- Be the driving force behind our revenue growth by proactively seeking new opportunities

- Own and manage the sales cycle from discovery to close, including qualification, solution presentation, negotiation, and closing.

- Educate potential customers on the immense value that offers

- Provide tailored solution recommendations based on customers' unique business needs and usage patterns

- Manage multiple customer relationships simultaneously, guiding them through various stages of the sales process

- Handle inbound customer inquiries with finesse, effectively addressing billing, legal, security, and technical concerns

- Act as the advocate for our customers, collecting valuable feedback to fuel ongoing improvements, including product enhancements

- Stay informed about industry trends, competitive offerings, and emerging technologies to effectively position the company’s products in the market

- Assist with additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to contribute to the team's success

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the Customer Success team and other teams to ensure smooth handover of clients and alignment on client feedback and product improvements.

- Develop strategic plans for targeted key accounts to expand usage and identify opportunities for upsell and cross-sell, ensuring long-term success and client satisfaction.

 Qualifications 

- Prior experience in B2B SaaS sales, with a proven track record of success in selling to mid-market accounts within the LATAM region.

- Exceptional proficiency in clear and concise spoken and written English and Spanish is a Must 

- A track record of successfully closing sales deals within a B2B SaaS company is highly preferred

- You're passionate about identifying customer needs and ensuring their satisfaction

- An ambitious and goal-driven mindset is crucial for success

- You thrive in a flexible and dynamic environment, showing resilience in the face of challenges

- While not required, the ability to speak Portuguese is a valuable asset

- Familiarity with solution selling or similar methodologies.

 Here's what's in for you 

- You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other'
