About BJAK 

 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

 Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 The Role 

 We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's Android Software Engineer.

 This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

 What You'll Own 

- 
 Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

- 
 Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

- 
 Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

- 
 Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

- 
 Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

- 
 Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

- 
 Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

 What We're Looking For 

- 
 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

- 
 Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

- 
 Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

- 
 Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

- 
 Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

- 
 Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

- 
 App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

 Tech Stack 

- 
 Kotlin

- 
 Jetpack Compose

- 
 Android SDK

- 
 Coroutines & Flow

- 
 SQL / NoSQL

- 
 TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 The Kind of Builder We Want 

- 
 Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

- 
 Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

- 
 Moves fast without creating messy code.

- 
 Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

- 
 Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

 This Role Is Not For 

- 
 Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

- 
 Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

- 
 People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

- 
 Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

- 
 People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 Location 

 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany .

 Language 

 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 Interview Process 

 Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Role-specific interview

 3. CEO / final round

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

 Oxide is growing, and so is the volume of in-game content. We're looking for a third Concept Artist to join our two talented artists and work on concepts from initial ideas through to final implementation.

 What You'll Be Doing: 

- 
 Support concepts through all stages of production, preparing materials for handoff to 3D, and providing direction for animation and VFX.

- 
 Create concepts for weapon skins, including upgradeable skins and progression lines (~80% of tasks).

- 
 Develop concepts for armor and gear skins (~20% of tasks).

- 
 Work with references, building side-collections and design variations, and refining concepts based on team feedback.

 Collaborate with game designers, 2D & 3D artists, animators, and the producer.

- 
 As needed: create concepts for new in-game assets (weapons, vehicles), locations, 2D icons, etc.

 Why You'll Enjoy Working With Us: 

- 
 Concepts reach players fast — we work in short sprints and regularly ship new content.

- 
 No endless revision cycles. We value speed and fresh ideas: if a concept doesn't land, we try a new approach and move on.

- 
 A comfortable working atmosphere: constructive feedback, a friendly team, and creative freedom.

 What We Expect From You: 

- 
 Experience creating concepts that made it through to final implementation in a shipped game.

- 
 A relevant portfolio featuring weapon, skin, and/or gear concepts in a realistic or semi-realistic style.

- 
 Understanding of 3D production specifics: concepts account for shape, silhouette, and materials, and read clearly for modelers without needing further interpretation.

- 
 Ability to work to a production-ready level: callouts, angle breakdowns, and material notes.

- 
 Skill in working with references: building collections and skin series without directly copying.

- 
 Willingness to work quickly and iteratively, with a calm attitude toward revisions and rejected ideas.

- 
 Russian - C1 level.

 A Strong Plus: 

- 
 Experience with character, armor, and gear concepts.

- 
 Experience working on mobile shooters or survival games.

- 
 Understanding of technical constraints on mobile platforms.

- 
 Confident use of AI tools in your working pipeline.

 What We Offer: 

- 
 Competitive salary.

- 
 Remote work format.

- 
 A passionate and supportive team that values creativity and ownership.

- 
 Opportunities for professional growth.

- 
 A culture built on initiative, transparency, and collaboration.

 Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

 Position Overview 

 The European 3PL Manager owns Nebius's network of external warehouses and the performance of the 3PL partners who run them. - Support internal and external (SOX) audits for inventory held by third parties.

- Coordination with Internal Teams

- Work with Security on access control, CCTV, pre-arrival information and secure-storage requirements at 3PL sites.

- Ensure accurate and timely data exchange between 3PL systems and Nebius ERP/WMS (integrations, ASNs, stock reports).

- Cost Management 

- Own the 3PL budget: storage, handling, value-added services and accessorial charges.

- Validate 3PL invoices against contracts and actual activity together with Back Office; resolve disputes.

- Manage 3PL exits and stock transfers with zero loss and full traceability.

- Maintain audit-ready documentation on contracts, SLAs, audits and incidents.

- Identify operational and dependency risks in the 3PL network and maintain contingency plans.

 Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks) 

 Are you a hands-on engineer who loves zero-to-one challenges? Do you want to build systems with real context and memory that do more than reason, use tools, and drive actual business outcomes? 

 About JetBrains 

 We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

 GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains, designed to give GTM teams and AI agents a shared business brain. Business context usually gets fragmented across CRMs, documents, dashboards, and people's heads. GrowthBricks brings that context together so agents and people can make decisions and execute effectively across the sales, marketing, and product stack.

 About GrowthBricks 

 GrowthBricks is a shared business brain for GTM teams and AI agents.

 It brings together the context that usually lives across CRM, docs, dashboards, tools, and people’s heads: who we sell to, why customers buy, what matters now, what we tried, and what worked. Agents and people use that context to decide what to do next and execute across the GTM stack.

 GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains.

 About the role 

 We’re looking for a hands-on Founding Tech Lead to build GrowthBricks from zero.

 You’ll work directly with the product founder and own the technical side of the product: architecture, core systems, integrations, and the agent layer.

 The core challenge is turning fragmented, changing business context into reliable memory and agent actions across tools and measuring whether those actions actually drive business outcomes.

 You’ll write a lot of the early code yourself, make the key technical decisions, and shape the product as we learn what works.

 What you’ll work on 

- Design the core architecture: business context, agents, tools, integrations, and feedback loops.

- Build agentic workflows that can reason over company context and act across CRM, sales, marketing, and product systems.

- Build context extractors from GTM team artifacts like sales calls, emails, internal documents, CRM state, marketing campaigns, etc.

- Work on prompting, context management, memory, tool use, and orchestration.

- Connect GrowthBricks to the existing GTM stack rather than rebuilding everything around it.

- Decide where to use MCP, APIs, frameworks, or third-party tools and where a custom solution is worth it.

- Prototype fast, discard weak ideas, and turn the useful ones into product primitives.

 We expect that you 

- Are a strong hands-on engineer who enjoys zero-to-one work.

- Have built with LLMs, agents, or agentic workflows used by real people, and improved them based on failures, evaluations, and user feedback.

- Understand how context, prompting, tools, and agent behavior fit together.

- Can design backend systems, APIs, data models, and integrations.

- Are comfortable making decisions before all the answers are known.

- Prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over unnecessary complexity.

 We’re especially interested if you 

- Have worked in solution engineering, sales engineering, pre-sales, or built software for GTM teams.

- Understand the modern GTM stack: CRM, enrichment, outbound, automation, and product signals.

- Have automated sales or marketing workflows, ideally with agents or LLMs.

- Have owned a technical product from a blank repo to something people actually used.

 GTM experience is not mandatory, but if you already understand how sales and marketing teams work, that is a strong advantage.

 What we offer 

- A competitive salary and strong benefits package.

- The runway and resources of an established company, with startup-level autonomy.

- A founding role with direct influence over both product and architecture.

- Real users and real workflows from day one.

- Freedom to choose the stack, tools, and technical approach.

- A chance to help define what an agent-native GTM product should look like.

We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.
